tanach-bereishit|1:1.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

tanach-bereishit|1:2.en: Now the earth was unformed and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep; and the spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters.

tanach-bereishit|1:3.en: And God said: 'Let there be light.' And there was light.

tanach-bereishit|1:4.en: And God saw the light, that it was good; and God divided the light from the darkness.

tanach-bereishit|1:5.en: And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

tanach-bereishit|1:6.en: And God said: 'Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.'

tanach-yeshayahu|42:5.en: Thus saith God the Lord, He that created the heavens, and stretched them forth, He that spread forth the earth and that which cometh out of it, He that giveth breath unto the people upon it, And spirit to them that walk therein:

tanach-yeshayahu|42:6.en: I the Lord have called thee in righteousness, And have taken hold of thy hand, And kept thee, and set thee for a covenant of the people, For a light of the nations;

tanach-yeshayahu|42:7.en: To open the blind eyes, To bring out the prisoners from the dungeon, And them that sit in darkness out of the prison-house.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:8.en: I am the Lord, that is My name; And My glory will I not give to another, Neither My praise to graven images.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:9.en: Behold, the former things are come to pass, And new things do I declare; Before they spring forth I tell you of them.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:10.en: Sing unto the Lord a new song, And His praise from the end of the earth; Ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein, The isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

tanach-mishlei|1:1.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel,

tanach-mishlei|1:2.en: To know wisdom and instruction; To comprehend the words of understanding;

tanach-mishlei|1:3.en: To receive the discipline of wisdom, Justice, and right, and equity;

tanach-mishlei|1:4.en: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion;

tanach-mishlei|1:5.en: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning, And the man of understanding may attain unto wise counsels;

tanach-mishlei|1:6.en: To understand a proverb, and a figure; The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

tanach-bereishit|1:7.en: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament; and it was so.

tanach-bereishit|1:8.en: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.

tanach-bereishit|1:9.en: And God said: 'Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear.' And it was so.

tanach-bereishit|1:10.en: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of the waters called He Seas; and God saw that it was good.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:11.en: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, The villages that Kedar doth inhabit; Let the inhabitants of Sela exult, Let them shout from the top of the mountains.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:12.en: Let them give glory unto the Lord, And declare His praise in the islands.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:13.en: The Lord will go forth as a mighty man, He will stir up jealousy like a man of war; He will cry, yea, He will shout aloud, He will prove Himself mighty against His enemies.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:14.en: I have long time held My peace, I have been still, and refrained Myself; Now will I cry like a travailing woman, Gasping and panting at once.

tanach-mishlei|1:7.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge; But the foolish despise wisdom and discipline.

tanach-mishlei|1:8.en: Hear, my son, the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the teaching of thy mother;

tanach-mishlei|1:9.en: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.

tanach-mishlei|1:10.en: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.

tanach-bereishit|1:11.en: And God said: 'Let the earth put forth grass, herb yielding seed, and fruit-tree bearing fruit after its kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth.' And it was so.

tanach-bereishit|1:12.en: And the earth brought forth grass, herb yielding seed after its kind, and tree bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after its kind; and God saw that it was good.

tanach-bereishit|1:13.en: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.

tanach-bereishit|1:14.en: And God said: 'Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years;

tanach-bereishit|1:15.en: and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth.' And it was so.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:15.en: I will make waste mountains and hills, And dry up all their herbs; And I will make the rivers islands, And will dry up the pools.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:16.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not, In paths that they knew not will I lead them; I will make darkness light before them, and rugged places plain. These things will I do, And I will not leave them undone.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:17.en: They shall be turned back, greatly ashamed, That trust in graven images, That say unto molten images: 'Ye are our gods.'

tanach-yeshayahu|42:18.en: Hear, ye deaf, And look, ye blind, that ye may see.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:19.en: Who is blind, but My servant? Or deaf, as My messenger that I send? Who is blind as he that is whole-hearted, And blind as the Lord's servant?

tanach-mishlei|1:11.en: If they say: 'Come with us, Let us lie in wait for blood, Let us lurk for the innocent without cause;

tanach-mishlei|1:12.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;

tanach-mishlei|1:13.en: We shall find all precious substance, We shall fill our houses with spoil;

tanach-mishlei|1:14.en: Cast in thy lot among us; Let us all have one purse'—

tanach-mishlei|1:15.en: My son, walk not thou in the way with them, Restrain thy foot from their path;

tanach-bereishit|1:16.en: And God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night; and the stars.

tanach-bereishit|1:17.en: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,

tanach-bereishit|1:18.en: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness; and God saw that it was good.

tanach-bereishit|1:19.en: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

tanach-bereishit|1:20.en: And God said: 'Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let fowl fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.'

tanach-bereishit|1:21.en: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that creepeth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after its kind, and every winged fowl after its kind; and God saw that it was good.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:20.en: Seeing many things, thou observest not; Opening the ears, he heareth not.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:21.en: The Lord was pleased, for His righteousness' sake, To make the teaching great and glorious.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:22.en: But this is a people robbed and spoiled, They are all of them snared in holes, And they are hid in prison-houses; They are for a prey, and none delivereth, For a spoil, and none saith: 'Restore.'

tanach-yeshayahu|42:23.en: Who among you will give ear to this? Who will hearken and hear for the time to come?

tanach-yeshayahu|42:24.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? Did not the Lord? He against whom we have sinned, And in whose ways they would not walk, Neither were they obedient unto His law.

tanach-yeshayahu|42:25.en: Therefore He poured upon him the fury of His anger, And the strength of battle; And it set him on fire round about, yet he knew not, And it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

tanach-mishlei|1:16.en: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.

tanach-mishlei|1:17.en: For in vain the net is spread In the eyes of any bird;

tanach-mishlei|1:18.en: And these lie in wait for their own blood, They lurk for their own lives.

tanach-mishlei|1:19.en: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

tanach-mishlei|1:20.en: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street, She uttereth her voice in the broad places;

tanach-mishlei|1:21.en: She calleth at the head of the noisy streets, At the entrances of the gates, in the city, she uttereth her words:

tanach-bereishit|1:22.en: And God blessed them, saying: 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.'

tanach-bereishit|1:23.en: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

tanach-bereishit|1:24.en: And God said: 'Let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after its kind.' And it was so.

tanach-bereishit|1:25.en: And God made the beast of the earth after its kind, and the cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the ground after its kind; and God saw that it was good.

tanach-bereishit|1:26.en: And God said: 'Let us make man in our image, after our likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.'

tanach-yeshayahu|43:1.en: But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, And He that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name, thou art Mine.

tanach-yeshayahu|43:2.en: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee, And through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee; When thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, Neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

tanach-yeshayahu|43:3.en: For I am the Lord thy God, The Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour; I have given Egypt as thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

tanach-yeshayahu|43:4.en: Since thou art precious in My sight, and honourable, And I have loved thee; Therefore will I give men for thee, And peoples for thy life.

tanach-yeshayahu|43:5.en: Fear not, for I am with thee; I will bring thy seed from the east, And gather thee from the west;

tanach-mishlei|1:22.en: 'How long, ye thoughtless, will ye love thoughtlessness? And how long will scorners delight them in scorning, And fools hate knowledge?

tanach-mishlei|1:23.en: Turn you at my reproof; Behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

tanach-mishlei|1:24.en: Because I have called, and ye refused, I have stretched out my hand, and no man attended,

tanach-mishlei|1:25.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof;

tanach-mishlei|1:26.en: I also, in your calamity, will laugh, I will mock when your dread cometh;

tanach-bereishit|1:27.en: And God created man in His own image, in the image of God created He him; male and female created He them.

tanach-bereishit|1:28.en: And God blessed them; and God said unto them: 'Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that creepeth upon the earth.'

tanach-bereishit|1:29.en: And God said: 'Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed—to you it shall be for food;

tanach-bereishit|1:30.en: and to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is a living soul, [I have given] every green herb for food.' And it was so.

tanach-bereishit|1:31.en: And God saw every thing that He had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

tanach-bereishit|2:1.en: And the heaven and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

tanach-bereishit|2:2.en: And on the seventh day God finished His work which He had made; and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had made.

tanach-bereishit|2:3.en: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it He rested from all His work which God in creating had made.

tanach-bereishit|2:4.en: These are the generations of the heaven and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made earth and heaven.

tanach-bereishit|2:5.en: No shrub of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground;

tanach-bereishit|2:6.en: but there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

tanach-bereishit|2:7.en: Then the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

tanach-bereishit|2:8.en: And the Lord God planted a garden eastward, in Eden; and there He put the man whom He had formed.

tanach-bereishit|2:9.en: And out of the ground made the Lord God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

tanach-bereishit|2:10.en: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became four heads.

tanach-bereishit|2:11.en: The name of the first is Pishon; that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

tanach-bereishit|2:12.en: and the gold of that land is good; there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

tanach-bereishit|2:13.en: And the name of the second river is Gihon; the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Cush.

tanach-bereishit|2:14.en: And the name of the third river is Tigris; that is it which goeth toward the east of Asshur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

tanach-bereishit|2:15.en: And the Lord God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

tanach-bereishit|2:16.en: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying: 'Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat;

tanach-bereishit|2:17.en: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it; for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.'

tanach-bereishit|2:18.en: And the Lord God said: 'It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.'

tanach-bereishit|2:19.en: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto the man to see what he would call them; and whatsoever the man would call every living creature, that was to be the name thereof.

tanach-bereishit|2:20.en: And the man gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found a help meet for him.

tanach-bereishit|2:21.en: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs, and closed up the place with flesh instead thereof.

tanach-bereishit|2:22.en: And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from the man, made He a woman, and brought her unto the man.

tanach-bereishit|2:23.en: And the man said: 'This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.'

tanach-bereishit|2:24.en: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife, and they shall be one flesh.

tanach-bereishit|2:25.en: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

tanach-bereishit|3:1.en: Now the serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman: 'Yea, hath God said: Ye shall not eat of any tree of the garden?'

tanach-bereishit|3:2.en: And the woman said unto the serpent: 'Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat;

tanach-bereishit|3:3.en: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said: Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.'

tanach-bereishit|3:4.en: And the serpent said unto the woman: 'Ye shall not surely die;

tanach-bereishit|3:5.en: for God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as God, knowing good and evil.'

tanach-bereishit|3:6.en: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat; and she gave also unto her husband with her, and he did eat.

tanach-bereishit|3:7.en: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig-leaves together, and made themselves girdles.

tanach-bereishit|3:8.en: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden toward the cool of the day; and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.

tanach-bereishit|3:9.en: And the Lord God called unto the man, and said unto him: 'Where art thou?'

tanach-bereishit|3:10.en: And he said: 'I heard Thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.'

tanach-bereishit|3:11.en: And He said: 'Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?'

tanach-bereishit|3:12.en: And the man said: 'The woman whom Thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.'

tanach-bereishit|3:13.en: And the Lord God said unto the woman: 'What is this thou hast done?' And the woman said: 'The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.'

tanach-bereishit|3:14.en: And the Lord God said unto the serpent: 'Because thou hast done this, cursed art thou from among all cattle, and from among all beasts of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life.

tanach-bereishit|3:15.en: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; they shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise their heel.'

tanach-bereishit|3:16.en: Unto the woman He said: 'I will greatly multiply thy pain and thy travail; in pain thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.'

tanach-bereishit|3:17.en: And unto Adam He said: 'Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying: Thou shalt not eat of it; cursed is the ground for thy sake; in toil shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life.

tanach-bereishit|3:18.en: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field.

tanach-bereishit|3:19.en: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken; for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.'

tanach-bereishit|3:20.en: And the man called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

tanach-bereishit|3:21.en: And the Lord God made for Adam and for his wife garments of skins, and clothed them.

tanach-bereishit|3:22.en: And the Lord God said: 'Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever.'

tanach-bereishit|3:23.en: Therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

tanach-bereishit|3:24.en: So He drove out the man; and He placed at the east of the garden of Eden the cherubim, and the flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way to the tree of life.

tanach-bereishit|4:1.en: And the man knew Eve his wife; and she conceived and bore Cain, and said: 'I have gotten a man with the help of the Lord.'

tanach-bereishit|4:2.en: And again she bore his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

tanach-bereishit|4:3.en: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|4:4.en: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering;

tanach-bereishit|4:5.en: but unto Cain and to his offering He had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

tanach-bereishit|4:6.en: And the Lord said unto Cain: 'Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

tanach-bereishit|4:7.en: If thou doest well, shall it not be lifted up? and if thou doest not well, sin coucheth at the door; and unto thee is its desire, but thou mayest rule over it.'

tanach-bereishit|4:8.en: And Cain spoke unto Abel his brother. And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

tanach-bereishit|4:9.en: And the Lord said unto Cain: 'Where is Abel thy brother?' And he said: 'I know not; am I my brother's keeper?'

tanach-bereishit|4:10.en: And He said: 'What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto Me from the ground.

tanach-bereishit|4:11.en: And now cursed art thou from the ground, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand.

tanach-bereishit|4:12.en: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a wanderer shalt thou be in the earth.'

tanach-bereishit|4:13.en: And Cain said unto the Lord: 'My punishment is greater than I can bear.

tanach-bereishit|4:14.en: Behold, Thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the land; and from Thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth; and it will come to pass, that whosoever findeth me will slay me.'

tanach-bereishit|4:15.en: And the Lord said unto him: 'Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold.' And the Lord set a sign for Cain, lest any finding him should smite him.

tanach-bereishit|4:16.en: And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

tanach-bereishit|4:17.en: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bore Enoch; and he builded a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son Enoch.

tanach-bereishit|4:18.en: And unto Enoch was born Irad; and Irad begot Mehujael; and Mehujael begot Methushael; and Methushael begot Lamech.

tanach-bereishit|4:19.en: And Lamech took unto him two wives; the name of one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

tanach-bereishit|4:20.en: And Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle.

tanach-bereishit|4:21.en: And his brother's name was Jubal; he was the father of all such as handle the harp and pipe.

tanach-bereishit|4:22.en: And Zillah, she also bore Tubal-cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron; and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.

tanach-bereishit|4:23.en: And Lamech said unto his wives: Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech; For I have slain a man for wounding me, And a young man for bruising me;

tanach-bereishit|4:24.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

tanach-bereishit|4:25.en: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bore a son, and called his name Seth: 'for God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.'

tanach-bereishit|4:26.en: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enosh; then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|5:1.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made He him;

tanach-bereishit|5:2.en: male and female created He them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

tanach-bereishit|5:3.en: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begot a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth.

tanach-bereishit|5:4.en: And the days of Adam after he begot Seth were eight hundred years; and he begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:5.en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:6.en: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.

tanach-bereishit|5:7.en: And Seth lived after he begot Enosh eight hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:8.en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:9.en: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Kenan.

tanach-bereishit|5:10.en: And Enosh lived after he begot Kenan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:11.en: And all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:12.en: And Kenan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalalel.

tanach-bereishit|5:13.en: And Kenan lived after he begot Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:14.en: And all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:15.en: And Mahalalel lived sixty and five years, and begot Jared.

tanach-bereishit|5:16.en: And Mahalalel lived after he begot Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:17.en: And all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety and five years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:18.en: And Jared lived a hundred sixty and two years, and begot Enoch.

tanach-bereishit|5:19.en: And Jared lived after he begot Enoch eight hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:20.en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:21.en: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begot Methuselah.

tanach-bereishit|5:22.en: And Enoch walked with God after he begot Methuselah three hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:23.en: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years.

tanach-bereishit|5:24.en: And Enoch walked with God, and he was not; for God took him.

tanach-bereishit|5:25.en: And Methuselah lived a hundred eighty and seven years, and begot Lamech.

tanach-bereishit|5:26.en: And Methuselah lived after he begot Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:27.en: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:28.en: And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two years, and begot a son.

tanach-bereishit|5:29.en: And he called his name Noah, saying: 'This same shall comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, which cometh from the ground which the Lord hath cursed.'

tanach-bereishit|5:30.en: And Lamech lived after he begot Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begot sons and daughters.

tanach-bereishit|5:31.en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years; and he died.

tanach-bereishit|5:32.en: And Noah was five hundred years old; and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

tanach-bereishit|6:1.en: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

tanach-bereishit|6:2.en: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives, whomsoever they chose.

tanach-bereishit|6:3.en: And the Lord said: 'My spirit shall not abide in man for ever, for that he also is flesh; therefore shall his days be a hundred and twenty years.'

tanach-bereishit|6:4.en: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bore children to them; the same were the mighty men that were of old, the men of renown.

tanach-bereishit|6:5.en: And the Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

tanach-bereishit|6:6.en: And it repented the Lord that He had made man on the earth, and it grieved Him at His heart.

tanach-bereishit|6:7.en: And the Lord said: 'I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and creeping thing, and fowl of the air; for it repenteth Me that I have made them.'

tanach-bereishit|6:8.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|18:1.en: And the Lord appeared unto him by the terebinths of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

tanach-bereishit|18:2.en: and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood over against him; and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed down to the earth,

tanach-bereishit|18:3.en: and said: 'My lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant.

tanach-bereishit|18:4.en: Let now a little water be fetched, and wash your feet, and recline yourselves under the tree.

tanach-bereishit|18:5.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and stay ye your heart; after that ye shall pass on; forasmuch as ye are come to your servant.' And they said: 'So do, as thou hast said.'

tanach-bereishit|18:6.en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said: 'Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:1.en: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying: 'Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the Lord; and the creditor is come to take unto him my two children to be bondmen.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:2.en: And Elisha said unto her: 'What shall I do for thee? tell me; what hast thou in the house?' And she said: 'Thy handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:3.en: Then he said: 'Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

tanach-melachim-b|4:4.en: And thou shalt go in, and shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and pour out into all those vessels; and thou shalt set aside that which is full.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:5.en: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons; they brought the vessels to her, and she poured out.

tanach-melachim-b|4:6.en: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son: 'Bring me yet a vessel.' And he said unto her: 'There is not a vessel more.' And the oil stayed.

tanach-mishlei|3:24.en: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid; Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

tanach-mishlei|3:25.en: Be not afraid of sudden terror, Neither of the destruction of the wicked, when it cometh;

tanach-mishlei|3:26.en: For the Lord will be thy confidence, And will keep thy foot from being caught.

tanach-mishlei|3:27.en: Withhold not good from him to whom it is due, When it is in the power of thy hand to do it.

tanach-mishlei|3:28.en: Say not unto thy neighbour: 'Go, and come again, And to-morrow I will give'; when thou hast it by thee.

tanach-mishlei|3:29.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, Seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

tanach-bereishit|18:7.en: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto the servant; and he hastened to dress it.

tanach-bereishit|18:8.en: And he took curd, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

tanach-bereishit|18:9.en: And they said unto him: 'Where is Sarah thy wife?' And he said: 'Behold, in the tent.'

tanach-bereishit|18:10.en: And He said: 'I will certainly return unto thee when the season cometh round; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son.' And Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.—

tanach-melachim-b|4:7.en: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said: 'Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy sons of the rest.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:8.en: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

tanach-melachim-b|4:9.en: And she said unto her husband: 'Behold now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God, that passeth by us continually.

tanach-melachim-b|4:10.en: Let us make, I pray thee, a little chamber on the roof; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick; and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.'

tanach-mishlei|3:30.en: Strive not with a man without cause, If he have done thee no harm.

tanach-mishlei|3:31.en: Envy thou not the man of violence, And choose none of his ways.

tanach-mishlei|3:32.en: For the perverse is an abomination to the Lord; But His counsel is with the upright.

tanach-mishlei|3:33.en: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked; But He blesseth the habitation of the righteous.

tanach-bereishit|18:11.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, and well stricken in age; it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.—

tanach-bereishit|18:12.en: And Sarah laughed within herself, saying: 'After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?'

tanach-bereishit|18:13.en: And the Lord said unto Abraham: 'Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying: Shall I of a surety bear a child, who am old?

tanach-bereishit|18:14.en: Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.'

tanach-bereishit|18:15.en: Then Sarah denied, saying: 'I laughed not'; for she was afraid. And He said: 'Nay; but thou didst laugh.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:11.en: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the upper chamber and lay there.

tanach-melachim-b|4:12.en: And he said to Gehazi his servant: 'Call this Shunammite.' And when he had called her, she stood before him.

tanach-melachim-b|4:13.en: And he said unto him: 'Say now unto her: Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host?' And she answered: 'I dwell among mine own people.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:14.en: And he said: 'What then is to be done for her?' And Gehazi answered: 'Verily she hath no son, and her husband is old.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:15.en: And he said: 'Call her.' And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

tanach-mishlei|3:34.en: If it concerneth the scorners, He scorneth them, But unto the humble He giveth grace.

tanach-mishlei|3:35.en: The wise shall inherit honour; But as for the fools, they carry away shame.

tanach-mishlei|4:1.en: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding.

tanach-mishlei|4:2.en: For I give you good doctrine; Forsake ye not my teaching.

tanach-mishlei|4:3.en: For I was a son unto my father, Tender and an only one in the sight of my mother.

tanach-bereishit|18:16.en: And the men rose up from thence, and looked out toward Sodom; and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

tanach-bereishit|18:17.en: And the Lord said: 'Shall I hide from Abraham that which I am doing;

tanach-bereishit|18:18.en: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

tanach-bereishit|18:19.en: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the Lord, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the Lord may bring upon Abraham that which He hath spoken of him.'

tanach-bereishit|18:20.en: And the Lord said: 'Verily, the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and, verily, their sin is exceeding grievous.

tanach-bereishit|18:21.en: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto Me; and if not, I will know.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:16.en: And he said: 'At this season, when the time cometh round, thou shalt embrace a son.' And she said: 'Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thy handmaid.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:17.en: And the woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time came round, as Elisha had said unto her.

tanach-melachim-b|4:18.en: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

tanach-melachim-b|4:19.en: And he said unto his father: 'My head, my head.' And he said to his servant: 'Carry him to his mother.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:20.en: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

tanach-melachim-b|4:21.en: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.

tanach-mishlei|4:4.en: And he taught me, and said unto me: 'Let thy heart hold fast my words, Keep my commandments, and live;

tanach-mishlei|4:5.en: Get wisdom, get understanding; Forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth;

tanach-mishlei|4:6.en: Forsake her not, and she will preserve thee; Love her, and she will keep thee.

tanach-mishlei|4:7.en: The beginning of wisdom is: Get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.

tanach-mishlei|4:8.en: Extol her, and she will exalt thee; She will bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

tanach-mishlei|4:9.en: She will give to thy head a chaplet of grace; A crown of glory will she bestow on thee.'

tanach-bereishit|18:22.en: And the men turned from thence, and went toward Sodom; but Abraham stood yet before the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|18:23.en: And Abraham drew near, and said: 'Wilt Thou indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

tanach-bereishit|18:24.en: Peradventure there are fifty righteous within the city; wilt Thou indeed sweep away and not forgive the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

tanach-bereishit|18:25.en: That be far from Thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked, that so the righteous should be as the wicked; that be far from Thee; shall not the judge of all the earth do justly?'

tanach-bereishit|18:26.en: And the Lord said: 'If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will forgive all the place for their sake.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:22.en: And she called unto her husband, and said: 'Send me, I pray thee, one of the servants, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come back.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:23.en: And he said: 'Wherefore wilt thou go to him to-day? it is neither new moon nor sabbath.' And she said: 'It shall be well.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:24.en: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant: 'Drive, and go forward; slacken me not the riding, except I bid thee.'

tanach-melachim-b|4:25.en: So she went, and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant: 'Behold, yonder is that Shunammite.

tanach-melachim-b|4:26.en: Run, I pray thee, now to meet her, and say unto her: Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child?' And she answered: 'It is well.'

tanach-mishlei|4:10.en: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; And the years of thy life shall be many.

tanach-mishlei|4:11.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in paths of uprightness.

tanach-mishlei|4:12.en: When thou goest, thy step shall not be straitened; And if thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

tanach-mishlei|4:13.en: Take fast hold of instruction, let her not go; Keep her, for she is thy life.

tanach-mishlei|4:14.en: Enter not into the path of the wicked, And walk not in the way of evil men.

tanach-bereishit|18:27.en: And Abraham answered and said: 'Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, who am but dust and ashes.

tanach-bereishit|18:28.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous; wilt Thou destroy all the city for lack of five?' And He said: 'I will not destroy it, if I find there forty and five.'

tanach-bereishit|18:29.en: And he spoke unto Him yet again, and said: 'Peradventure there shall be forty found there.' And He said: 'I will not do it for the forty's sake.'

tanach-bereishit|18:30.en: And he said: 'Oh, let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak. Peradventure there shall thirty be found there.' And He said: 'I will not do it, if I find thirty there.'

tanach-bereishit|18:31.en: And he said: 'Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord. Peradventure there shall be twenty found there.' And He said: 'I will not destroy it for the twenty's sake.'

tanach-bereishit|18:32.en: And he said: 'Oh, let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once. Peradventure ten shall be found there.' And He said: 'I will not destroy it for the ten's sake.'

tanach-bereishit|18:33.en: And the Lord went His way, as soon as He had left off speaking to Abraham; and Abraham returned unto his place.

tanach-bereishit|19:1.en: And the two angels came to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom; and Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them; and he fell down on his face to the earth;

tanach-bereishit|19:2.en: and he said: 'Behold now, my lords, turn aside, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your way.' And they said: 'Nay; but we will abide in the broad place all night.'

tanach-bereishit|19:3.en: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

tanach-bereishit|19:4.en: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

tanach-bereishit|19:5.en: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him: 'Where are the men that came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.'

tanach-bereishit|19:6.en: And Lot went out unto them to the door, and shut the door after him.

tanach-bereishit|19:7.en: And he said: 'I pray you, my brethren, do not so wickedly.

tanach-bereishit|19:8.en: Behold now, I have two daughters that have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes; only unto these men do nothing; forasmuch as they are come under the shadow of my roof.'

tanach-bereishit|19:9.en: And they said: 'Stand back.' And they said: 'This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs play the judge; now will we deal worse with thee, than with them.' And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and drew near to break the door.

tanach-bereishit|19:10.en: But the men put forth their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and the door they shut.

tanach-bereishit|19:11.en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great; so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

tanach-bereishit|19:12.en: And the men said unto Lot: 'Hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomsoever thou hast in the city; bring them out of the place;

tanach-bereishit|19:13.en: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxed great before the Lord; and the Lord hath sent us to destroy it.'

tanach-bereishit|19:14.en: And Lot went out, and spoke unto his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said: 'Up, get you out of this place; for the Lord will destroy the city.' But he seemed unto his sons-in-law as one that jested.

tanach-bereishit|19:15.en: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying: 'Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters that are here; lest thou be swept away in the iniquity of the city.'

tanach-bereishit|19:16.en: But he lingered; and the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the Lord being merciful unto him. And they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

tanach-bereishit|19:17.en: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said: 'Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the Plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be swept away.'

tanach-bereishit|19:18.en: And Lot said unto them: 'Oh, not so, my lord;

tanach-bereishit|19:19.en: behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shown unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest the evil overtake me, and I die.

tanach-bereishit|19:20.en: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one; oh, let me escape thither—is it not a little one?—and my soul shall live.'

tanach-bereishit|19:21.en: And he said unto him: 'See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.

tanach-bereishit|19:22.en: Hasten thou, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither.'—Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.—

tanach-bereishit|19:23.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot came unto Zoar.

tanach-bereishit|19:24.en: Then the Lord caused to rain upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;

tanach-bereishit|19:25.en: and He overthrow those cities, and all the Plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

tanach-bereishit|19:26.en: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

tanach-bereishit|19:27.en: And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|19:28.en: And he looked out toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the Plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

tanach-bereishit|19:29.en: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.

tanach-bereishit|19:30.en: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar; and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

tanach-bereishit|19:31.en: And the first-born said unto the younger: 'Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth.

tanach-bereishit|19:32.en: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.'

tanach-bereishit|19:33.en: And they made their father drink wine that night. And the first-born went in, and lay with her father; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

tanach-bereishit|19:34.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the first-born said unto the younger: 'Behold, I lay yesternight with my father. Let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.'

tanach-bereishit|19:35.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also. And the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

tanach-bereishit|19:36.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

tanach-bereishit|19:37.en: And the first-born bore a son, and called his name Moab—the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

tanach-bereishit|19:38.en: And the younger, she also bore a son, and called his name Benammi—the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

tanach-bereishit|20:1.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the land of the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur; and he sojourned in Gerar.

tanach-bereishit|20:2.en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife: 'She is my sister.' And Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

tanach-bereishit|20:3.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him: 'Behold, thou shalt die, because of the woman whom thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.'

tanach-bereishit|20:4.en: Now Abimelech had not come near her; and he said: 'Lord, wilt Thou slay even a righteous nation?

tanach-bereishit|20:5.en: Said he not himself unto me: She is my sister? and she, even she herself said: He is my brother. In the simplicity of my heart and the innocency of my hands have I done this.'

tanach-bereishit|20:6.en: And God said unto him in the dream: 'Yea, I know that in the simplicity of thy heart thou hast done this, and I also withheld thee from sinning against Me. Therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

tanach-bereishit|20:7.en: Now therefore restore the man's wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live; and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.'

tanach-bereishit|20:8.en: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears; and the men were sore afraid.

tanach-bereishit|20:9.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him: 'What hast thou done unto us? and wherein have I sinned against thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.'

tanach-bereishit|20:10.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham: 'What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?'

tanach-bereishit|20:11.en: And Abraham said: 'Because I thought: Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

tanach-bereishit|20:12.en: And moreover she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and so she became my wife.

tanach-bereishit|20:13.en: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her: This is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me: He is my brother.'

tanach-bereishit|20:14.en: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

tanach-bereishit|20:15.en: And Abimelech said: 'Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.'

tanach-bereishit|20:16.en: And unto Sarah he said: 'Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver; behold, it is for thee a covering of the eyes to all that are with thee; and before all men thou art righted.'

tanach-bereishit|20:17.en: And Abraham prayed unto God; and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maid-servants; and they bore children.

tanach-bereishit|20:18.en: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.

tanach-bereishit|21:1.en: And the Lord remembered Sarah as He had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as He had spoken.

tanach-bereishit|21:2.en: And Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

tanach-bereishit|21:3.en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

tanach-bereishit|21:4.en: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

tanach-bereishit|21:5.en: And Abraham was a hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

tanach-bereishit|21:6.en: And Sarah said: 'God hath made laughter for me; every one that heareth will laugh on account of me.'

tanach-bereishit|21:7.en: And she said: 'Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should give children suck? for I have borne him a son in his old age.'

tanach-bereishit|21:8.en: And the child grew, and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

tanach-bereishit|21:9.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne unto Abraham, making sport.

tanach-bereishit|21:10.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham: 'Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.'

tanach-bereishit|21:11.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight on account of his son.

tanach-bereishit|21:12.en: And God said unto Abraham: 'Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah saith unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall seed be called to thee.

tanach-bereishit|21:13.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.'

tanach-bereishit|21:14.en: And Abraham arose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away; and she departed, and strayed in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

tanach-bereishit|21:15.en: And the water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

tanach-bereishit|21:16.en: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot; for she said: 'Let me not look upon the death of the child.' And she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

tanach-bereishit|21:17.en: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her: 'What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

tanach-bereishit|21:18.en: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him fast by thy hand; for I will make him a great nation.'

tanach-bereishit|21:19.en: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

tanach-bereishit|21:20.en: And God was with the lad, and he grew; and he dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

tanach-bereishit|21:21.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran; and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|21:22.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his host spoke unto Abraham, saying: 'God is with thee in all that thou doest.

tanach-bereishit|21:23.en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son; but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.'

tanach-bereishit|21:25.en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of the well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

tanach-bereishit|21:26.en: And Abimelech said: 'I know not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to-day.'

tanach-bereishit|21:27.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and they two made a covenant.

tanach-bereishit|21:28.en: And Abraham set seven ewe-lambs of the flock by themselves.

tanach-bereishit|21:29.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham: 'What mean these seven ewe-lambs which thou hast set by themselves?'

tanach-bereishit|21:30.en: And he said: 'Verily, these seven ewe-lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that it may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.'

tanach-bereishit|21:31.en: Wherefore that place was called Beer-sheba; because there they swore both of them.

tanach-bereishit|21:32.en: So they made a covenant at Beer-sheba; and Abimelech rose up, and Phicol the captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

tanach-bereishit|21:33.en: And Abraham planted a tamarisk-tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the Everlasting God.

tanach-bereishit|21:34.en: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.

tanach-bereishit|22:1.en: And it came to pass after these things, that God did prove Abraham, and said unto him: 'Abraham'; and he said: 'Here am I.'

tanach-bereishit|22:2.en: And He said: 'Take now thy son, thine only son, whom thou lovest, even Isaac, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt-offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.'

tanach-bereishit|22:3.en: And Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he cleaved the wood for the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

tanach-bereishit|22:4.en: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

tanach-bereishit|22:5.en: And Abraham said unto his young men: 'Abide ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will go yonder; and we will worship, and come back to you.'

tanach-bereishit|22:6.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took in his hand the fire and the knife; and they went both of them together.

tanach-bereishit|22:7.en: And Isaac spoke unto Abraham his father, and said: 'My father.' And he said: 'Here am I, my son.' And he said: 'Behold the fire and the wood; but where is the lamb for a burnt-offering?'

tanach-bereishit|22:8.en: And Abraham said: 'God will provide Himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son.' So they went both of them together.

apparatus.text: Heb. jireh; that is see for Himself.

tanach-bereishit|22:9.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.

tanach-bereishit|22:10.en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

tanach-bereishit|22:11.en: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said: 'Abraham, Abraham.' And he said: 'Here am I.'

tanach-bereishit|22:12.en: And he said: 'Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him; for now I know that thou art a God-fearing man, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, from Me.'

tanach-bereishit|22:13.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. And Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.

tanach-bereishit|22:14.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Adonaijireh; as it is said to this day: 'In the mount where the Lord is seen.'

tanach-bereishit|22:15.en: And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham a second time out of heaven,

tanach-bereishit|22:16.en: and said: 'By Myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son,

tanach-bereishit|22:17.en: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea-shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

tanach-bereishit|22:18.en: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast hearkened to My voice.'

tanach-bereishit|22:19.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

tanach-bereishit|22:20.en: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying: 'Behold, Milcah, she also hath borne children unto thy brother Nahor:

tanach-bereishit|22:21.en: Uz his first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram;

tanach-bereishit|22:22.en: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.'

tanach-bereishit|22:23.en: And Bethuel begot Rebekah; these eight did Milcah bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

tanach-bereishit|22:24.en: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she also bore Tebah, and Gaham, and Tahash, and Maacah.

tanach-bereishit|23:1.en: And the life of Sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years; these were the years of the life of Sarah.

tanach-bereishit|23:2.en: And Sarah died in Kiriath-arba—the same is Hebron—in the land of Canaan; and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

tanach-bereishit|23:3.en: And Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke unto the children of Heth, saying:

tanach-bereishit|23:4.en: 'I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.'

tanach-bereishit|23:5.en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him:

tanach-bereishit|23:6.en: 'Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us; in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.'

tanach-melachim-a|1:1.en: Now King David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he could get no heat.

tanach-melachim-a|1:2.en: Wherefore his servants said unto him: 'Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin; and let her stand before the king, and be a companion unto him; and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.'

tanach-melachim-a|1:3.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

tanach-melachim-a|1:4.en: And the damsel was very fair; and she became a companion unto the king, and ministered to him; but the king knew her not.

tanach-melachim-a|1:5.en: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying: 'I will be king'; and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

tanach-melachim-a|1:6.en: And his father had not grieved him all his life in saying: 'Why hast thou done so?' and he was also a very goodly man; and he was born after Absalom.

tanach-mishlei|4:15.en: Avoid it, pass not by it; Turn from it, and pass on.

tanach-mishlei|4:16.en: For they sleep not, except they have done evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

tanach-mishlei|4:17.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.

tanach-mishlei|4:18.en: But the path of the righteous is as the light of dawn, That shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

tanach-mishlei|4:19.en: The way of the wicked is as darkness; They know not at what they stumble.

tanach-mishlei|4:20.en: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.

tanach-bereishit|23:7.en: And Abraham rose up, and bowed down to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

tanach-bereishit|23:8.en: And he spoke with them, saying: 'If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

tanach-bereishit|23:9.en: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for the full price let him give it to me in the midst of you for a possession of a burying-place.'

tanach-bereishit|23:10.en: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the children of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying:

tanach-melachim-a|1:7.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they following Adonijah helped him.

tanach-melachim-a|1:8.en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men that belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

tanach-melachim-a|1:9.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En-rogel; and he called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants;

tanach-melachim-a|1:10.en: but Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

tanach-mishlei|4:21.en: Let them not depart from thine eyes; Keep them in the midst of thy heart.

tanach-mishlei|4:22.en: For they are life unto those that find them, And health to all their flesh.

tanach-mishlei|4:23.en: Above all that thou guardest keep thy heart; For out of it are the issues of life.

tanach-mishlei|4:24.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee.

tanach-bereishit|23:11.en: 'Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee; bury thy dead.'

tanach-bereishit|23:12.en: And Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.

tanach-bereishit|23:13.en: And he spoke unto Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, saying: 'But if thou wilt, I pray thee, hear me: I will give the price of the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.'

tanach-bereishit|23:14.en: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him:

tanach-bereishit|23:15.en: 'My lord, hearken unto me: a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver, what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.'

tanach-melachim-a|1:11.en: Then Nathan spoke unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying: 'Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

tanach-melachim-a|1:12.en: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

tanach-melachim-a|1:13.en: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him: Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thy handmaid, saying: Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

tanach-melachim-a|1:14.en: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.'

tanach-melachim-a|1:15.en: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber.—Now the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.—

tanach-mishlei|4:25.en: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

tanach-mishlei|4:26.en: Make plain the path of thy feet, And let all thy ways be established.

tanach-mishlei|4:27.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left; Remove thy foot from evil.

tanach-mishlei|5:1.en: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding;

tanach-mishlei|5:2.en: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.

tanach-bereishit|23:16.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

tanach-bereishit|23:17.en: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the border thereof round about, were made sure

tanach-bereishit|23:18.en: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

tanach-bereishit|23:19.en: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre—the same is Hebron—in the land of Canaan.

tanach-bereishit|23:20.en: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a burying-place by the children of Heth.

tanach-bereishit|24:1.en: And Abraham was old, well stricken in age; and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.

tanach-melachim-a|1:16.en: And Bath-sheba bowed, and prostrated herself unto the king. And the king said: 'What wouldest thou?'

tanach-melachim-a|1:17.en: And she said unto him: 'My lord, thou didst swear by the Lord thy God unto thy handmaid: Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

tanach-melachim-a|1:18.en: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and thou, my lord the king, knowest it not.

tanach-melachim-a|1:19.en: And he hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar, the priest, and Joab the captain of the host; but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

tanach-melachim-a|1:20.en: And thou, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

tanach-melachim-a|1:21.en: Otherwise it will come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.'

tanach-mishlei|5:3.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil;

tanach-mishlei|5:4.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.

tanach-mishlei|5:5.en: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on the nether-world;

tanach-mishlei|5:6.en: Lest she should walk the even path of life, Her ways wander, but she knoweth it not.

tanach-mishlei|5:7.en: Now therefore, O ye children, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.

tanach-mishlei|5:8.en: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;

tanach-bereishit|24:2.en: And Abraham said unto his servant, the elder of his house, that ruled over all that he had: 'Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh.

tanach-bereishit|24:3.en: And I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell.

tanach-bereishit|24:4.en: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son, even for Isaac.'

tanach-bereishit|24:5.en: And the servant said unto him: 'Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land; must I needs bring thy son back unto the land from whence thou camest?'

tanach-bereishit|24:6.en: And Abraham said unto him: 'Beware thou that thou bring not my son back thither.

tanach-melachim-a|1:22.en: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

tanach-melachim-a|1:23.en: And they told the king, saying: 'Behold Nathan the prophet.' And when he was come in before the king, he bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.

tanach-melachim-a|1:24.en: And Nathan said: 'My lord, O king, hast thou said: Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

tanach-melachim-a|1:25.en: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say: Long live king Adonijah.

tanach-melachim-a|1:26.en: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon hath he not called.

tanach-mishlei|5:9.en: Lest thou give thy vigour unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;

tanach-mishlei|5:10.en: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labours be in the house of an alien;

tanach-mishlei|5:11.en: And thou moan, when thine end cometh, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

tanach-mishlei|5:12.en: And say: 'How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;

tanach-mishlei|5:13.en: Neither have I hearkened to the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

tanach-bereishit|24:7.en: The Lord, the God of heaven, who took me from my father's house, and from the land of my nativity, and who spoke unto me, and who swore unto me, saying: Unto thy seed will I give this land; He will send His angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from thence.

tanach-bereishit|24:8.en: And if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath; only thou shalt not bring my son back thither.'

tanach-bereishit|24:9.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

tanach-bereishit|24:10.en: And the servant took ten camels, of the camels of his master, and departed; having all goodly things of his master's in his hand; and he arose, and went to Aram-naharaim, unto the city of Nahor.

tanach-bereishit|24:11.en: And he made the camels to kneel down without the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

tanach-bereishit|24:12.en: And he said: 'O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, send me, I pray Thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.

tanach-bereishit|24:13.en: Behold, I stand by the fountain of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water.

tanach-bereishit|24:14.en: So let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say: Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say: Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also; let the same be she that Thou hast appointed for Thy servant, even for Isaac; and thereby shall I know that Thou hast shown kindness unto my master.'

tanach-bereishit|24:15.en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

tanach-bereishit|24:16.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her; and she went down to the fountain, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

tanach-bereishit|24:17.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said: 'Give me to drink, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher.'

tanach-bereishit|24:18.en: And she said: 'Drink, my lord'; and she hastened, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

tanach-bereishit|24:19.en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said: 'I will draw for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.'

tanach-bereishit|24:20.en: And she hastened, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

tanach-bereishit|24:21.en: And the man looked stedfastly on her; holding his peace, to know whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.

tanach-bereishit|24:22.en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

tanach-bereishit|24:23.en: and said: 'Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee. Is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?'

tanach-bereishit|24:24.en: And she said unto him: 'I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore unto Nahor.'

tanach-bereishit|24:25.en: She said moreover unto him: 'We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.'

tanach-bereishit|24:26.en: And the man bowed his head, and prostrated himself before the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|24:27.en: And he said: 'Blessed be the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who hath not forsaken His mercy and His truth toward my master; as for me, the Lord hath led me in the way to the house of my master's brethren.'

tanach-bereishit|24:28.en: And the damsel ran, and told her mother's house according to these words.

tanach-bereishit|24:29.en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban; and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain.

tanach-bereishit|24:30.en: And it came to pass, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying: 'Thus spoke the man unto me, 'that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the fountain.

tanach-bereishit|24:31.en: And he said: 'Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have cleared the house, and made room for the camels.'

tanach-bereishit|24:32.en: And the man came into the house, and he ungirded the camels; and he gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men that were with him.

tanach-bereishit|24:33.en: And there was set food before him to eat; but he said: 'I will not eat, until I have told mine errand.' And he said: 'Speak on.'

tanach-bereishit|24:34.en: And he said: 'I am Abraham's servant.

tanach-bereishit|24:35.en: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great; and He hath given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and men-servants and maid-servants, and camels and asses.

tanach-bereishit|24:36.en: And Sarah my master's wife bore a son to my master when she was old; and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

tanach-bereishit|24:37.en: And my master made me swear, saying: Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell.

tanach-bereishit|24:38.en: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.

tanach-bereishit|24:39.en: And I said unto my master: Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

tanach-bereishit|24:40.en: And he said unto me: The Lord, before whom I walk, will send His angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house;

tanach-bereishit|24:41.en: then shalt thou be clear from my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give her not to thee, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

tanach-bereishit|24:42.en: And I came this day unto the fountain, and said: O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, if now Thou do prosper my way which I go:

tanach-bereishit|24:43.en: behold, I stand by the fountain of water; and let it come to pass, that the maiden that cometh forth to draw, to whom I shall say: Give me, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher to drink;

tanach-bereishit|24:44.en: and she shall say to me: Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels; let the same be the woman whom the Lord hath appointed for my master's son.

tanach-bereishit|24:45.en: And before I had done speaking to my heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the fountain, and drew. And I said unto her: Let me drink, I pray thee.

tanach-bereishit|24:46.en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said: Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also. So I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

tanach-bereishit|24:47.en: And I asked her, and said: Whose daughter art thou? And she said: The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bore unto him. And I put the ring upon her nose, and the bracelets upon her hands.

tanach-bereishit|24:48.en: And I bowed my head, and prostrated myself before the Lord, and blessed the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son.

tanach-bereishit|24:49.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me; and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.'

tanach-bereishit|24:50.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said: 'The thing proceedeth from the Lord; we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

tanach-bereishit|24:51.en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the Lord hath spoken.'

tanach-bereishit|24:52.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth unto the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|24:53.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah; he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

tanach-bereishit|24:54.en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said: 'Send me away unto my master.'
