tanach-bereishit|24:55.en: And her brother and her mother said: 'Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.'

tanach-bereishit|24:56.en: And he said unto them: 'Delay me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.'

tanach-bereishit|24:57.en: And they said: 'We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.'

tanach-bereishit|24:58.en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her: 'Wilt thou go with this man?' And she said: 'I will go.'

tanach-bereishit|24:59.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

tanach-bereishit|24:60.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her: 'Our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let thy seed possess the gate of those that hate them.'

tanach-bereishit|24:61.en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man. And the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

tanach-bereishit|24:62.en: And Isaac came from the way of Beer-lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the land of the South.

tanach-bereishit|24:63.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide; and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.

tanach-bereishit|24:64.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she alighted from the camel.

tanach-bereishit|24:65.en: And she said unto the servant: 'What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us?' And the servant said: 'It is my master.' And she took her veil, and covered herself.

tanach-bereishit|24:66.en: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

tanach-bereishit|24:67.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her. And Isaac was comforted for his mother.

tanach-bereishit|25:1.en: And Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

tanach-bereishit|25:2.en: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

tanach-bereishit|25:3.en: And Jokshan begot Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

tanach-bereishit|25:4.en: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

tanach-bereishit|25:5.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

tanach-bereishit|25:6.en: But unto the sons of the concubines, that Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts; and he sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

tanach-bereishit|25:7.en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.

tanach-bereishit|25:8.en: And Abraham expired, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

tanach-bereishit|25:9.en: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

tanach-bereishit|25:10.en: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth; there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

tanach-bereishit|25:11.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed Isaac his son; and Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.

tanach-bereishit|25:12.en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bore unto Abraham.

tanach-bereishit|25:13.en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

tanach-bereishit|25:14.en: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa;

tanach-bereishit|25:15.en: Hadad, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedem;

tanach-bereishit|25:16.en: these are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments; twelve princes according to their nations.

tanach-bereishit|25:17.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years; and he expired and died; and was gathered unto his people.

tanach-bereishit|25:18.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Asshur: over against all his brethren he did settle.

tanach-bereishit|25:19.en: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begot Isaac.

tanach-bereishit|25:20.en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean, of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Aramean, to be his wife.

tanach-bereishit|25:21.en: And Isaac entreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren; and the Lord let Himself be entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

tanach-bereishit|25:22.en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said: 'If it be so, wherefore do I live?' And she went to inquire of the Lord.

tanach-bereishit|25:23.en: And the Lord said unto her: Two nations are in thy womb, And two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels; And the one people shall be stronger than the other people; And the elder shall serve the younger.

tanach-bereishit|25:24.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

tanach-malachi|1:1.en: The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.

tanach-malachi|1:2.en: I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say: 'Wherein hast Thou loved us?' Was not Esau Jacob's brother? Saith the Lord; Yet I loved Jacob;

tanach-malachi|1:3.en: But Esau I hated, And made his mountains a desolation, And gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.

tanach-malachi|1:4.en: Whereas Edom saith: 'We are beaten down, But we will return and build the waste places'; Thus saith the Lord of hosts: They shall build, but I will throw down; And they shall be called The border of wickedness, And The people whom the Lord execrateth for ever.

tanach-malachi|1:5.en: And your eyes shall see, And ye shall say: 'The Lord is great beyond the border of Israel.'

tanach-malachi|1:6.en: A son honoureth his father, And a servant his master; If then I be a father, Where is My honour? And if I be a master, Where is My fear? Saith the Lord of hosts Unto you, O priests, that despise My name. And ye say: 'Wherein have we despised Thy name?'

tanach-mishlei|5:14.en: I was well nigh in all evil In the midst of the congregation and assembly.'

tanach-mishlei|5:15.en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.

tanach-mishlei|5:16.en: Let thy springs be dispersed abroad, And courses of water in the streets.

tanach-mishlei|5:17.en: Let them be only thine own, And not strangers' with thee.

tanach-mishlei|5:18.en: Let thy fountain be blessed; And have joy of the wife of thy youth.

tanach-mishlei|5:19.en: A lovely hind and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; With her love be thou ravished always.

tanach-bereishit|25:25.en: And the first came forth ruddy, all over like a hairy mantle; and they called his name Esau.

tanach-bereishit|25:26.en: And after that came forth his brother, and his hand had hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob. And Isaac was threescore years old when she bore them.

apparatus.text: That is, One that takes by the heel, or, supplants.

tanach-bereishit|25:27.en: And the boys grew; and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.

tanach-bereishit|25:28.en: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison; and Rebekah loved Jacob.

tanach-malachi|1:7.en: Ye offer polluted bread upon Mine altar. And ye say: 'Wherein have we polluted Thee?' In that ye say: 'The table of the Lord is contemptible.'

tanach-malachi|1:8.en: And when ye offer the blind for sacrifice, it is no evil! And when ye offer the lame and sick, it is no evil! Present it now unto thy governor; Will he be pleased with thee? Or will he accept thy person? Saith the Lord of hosts.

tanach-malachi|1:9.en: And now, I pray you, entreat the favour of God That He may be gracious unto us!— This hath been of your doing.— Will He accept any of your persons? Saith the Lord of hosts.

tanach-malachi|1:10.en: Oh that there were even one among you that would shut the doors, That ye might not kindle fire on Mine altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you, Saith the Lord of hosts, Neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

tanach-mishlei|5:20.en: Why then wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of an alien?

tanach-mishlei|5:21.en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, And He maketh even all his paths.

tanach-mishlei|5:22.en: His own iniquities shall ensnare the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.

tanach-mishlei|5:23.en: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall reel.

tanach-bereishit|25:29.en: And Jacob sod pottage; and Esau came in from the field, and he was faint.

tanach-bereishit|25:30.en: And Esau said to Jacob: 'Let me swallow, I pray thee, some of this red, red pottage; for I am faint.' Therefore was his name called Edom.

tanach-bereishit|25:31.en: And Jacob said: 'Sell me first thy birthright.'

tanach-bereishit|25:32.en: And Esau said: 'Behold, I am at the point to die; and what profit shall the birthright do to me?'

tanach-bereishit|25:33.en: And Jacob said: 'Swear to me first'; and he swore unto him; and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

tanach-malachi|1:11.en: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same My name is great among the nations; And in every place offerings are presented unto My name, Even pure oblations; For My name is great among the nations, Saith the Lord of hosts.

tanach-malachi|1:12.en: But ye profane it, In that ye say: 'The table of the Lord is polluted, And the fruit thereof, even the food thereof, is contemptible.'

tanach-malachi|1:13.en: Ye say also: 'Behold, what a weariness is it!' And ye have snuffed at it, Saith the Lord of hosts; And ye have brought that which was taken by violence, And the lame, and the sick; Thus ye bring the offering; Should I accept this of your hand? Saith the Lord.

tanach-malachi|1:14.en: But cursed be he that dealeth craftily, Whereas he hath in his flock a male, And voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a blemished thing; For I am a great King, Saith the Lord of hosts, And My name is feared among the nations.

tanach-malachi|2:1.en: And now, this commandment Is for you, O ye priests.

tanach-mishlei|6:1.en: My son, if thou art become surety for thy neighbour, If thou hast struck thy hands for a stranger—

tanach-mishlei|6:2.en: Thou art snared by the words of thy mouth, Thou art caught by the words of thy mouth—

tanach-mishlei|6:3.en: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, Seeing thou art come into the hand of thy neighbour; Go, humble thyself, and urge thy neighbour.

tanach-mishlei|6:4.en: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

tanach-mishlei|6:5.en: Deliver thyself as a gazelle from the hand [of the hunter], And as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

tanach-bereishit|25:34.en: And Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

tanach-bereishit|26:1.en: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

tanach-bereishit|26:2.en: And the Lord appeared unto him, and said: 'Go not down unto Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of.

tanach-bereishit|26:3.en: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore unto Abraham thy father;

tanach-bereishit|26:4.en: and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these lands; and by thy seed shall all the nations of the earth bless themselves;

tanach-bereishit|26:5.en: because that Abraham hearkened to My voice, and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.'

tanach-malachi|2:2.en: If ye will not hearken, and if ye will not lay it to heart, To give glory unto My name, Saith the Lord of hosts, Then will I send the curse upon you, And I will curse your blessings; Yea, I curse them, Because ye do not lay it to heart.

tanach-malachi|2:3.en: Behold, I will rebuke the seed for your hurt, And will spread dung upon your faces, Even the dung of your sacrifices; And ye shall be taken away unto it.

tanach-malachi|2:4.en: Know then that I have sent This commandment unto you, That My covenant might be with Levi, Saith the Lord of hosts.

tanach-malachi|2:5.en: My covenant was with him Of life and peace, and I gave them to him, And of fear, and he feared Me, And was afraid of My name.

tanach-malachi|2:6.en: The law of truth was in his mouth And unrighteousness was not found in his lips; He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, And did turn many away from iniquity.

tanach-malachi|2:7.en: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, And they should seek the law at his mouth; For he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.

tanach-mishlei|6:6.en: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; Consider her ways, and be wise;

tanach-mishlei|6:7.en: Which having no chief, Overseer, or ruler,

tanach-mishlei|6:8.en: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gatherest her food in the harvest.

tanach-mishlei|6:9.en: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? When wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

tanach-mishlei|6:10.en: 'Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep'—

tanach-mishlei|6:11.en: So shall thy poverty come as a runner, And thy want as an armed man.

tanach-bereishit|26:7.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said: 'She is my sister'; for he feared to say: 'My wife'; 'lest the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah, because she is fair to look upon.'

tanach-bereishit|26:8.en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

tanach-bereishit|26:9.en: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said: 'Behold, of a surety she is thy wife; and how saidst thou: She is my sister?' And Isaac said unto him: 'Because I said: Lest I die because of her.'

tanach-bereishit|26:10.en: And Abimelech said: 'What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might easily have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.'

tanach-malachi|2:8.en: But ye are turned aside out of the way; Ye have caused many to stumble in the law; Ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, Saith the Lord of hosts.

tanach-malachi|2:9.en: Therefore have I also made you Contemptible and base before all the people, According as ye have not kept My ways, But have had respect of persons in the law.

tanach-malachi|2:10.en: Have we not all one father? Hath not one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, Profaning the covenant of our fathers?

tanach-malachi|2:11.en: Judah hath dealt treacherously, And an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; For Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which He loveth, And hath married the daughter of a strange god.

tanach-malachi|2:12.en: May the Lord cut off to the man that doeth this Him that calleth and him that answereth out of the tents of Jacob, And him that offereth an offering unto the Lord of hosts.

tanach-mishlei|6:12.en: A base person, a man of iniquity, Is he that walketh with a froward mouth;

tanach-mishlei|6:13.en: That winketh with his eyes, that scrapeth with his feet, That pointeth with his fingers;

tanach-mishlei|6:14.en: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth evil continually; He soweth discord.

tanach-mishlei|6:15.en: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.

tanach-mishlei|6:16.en: There are six things which the Lord hateth, Yea, seven which are an abomination unto Him:

tanach-bereishit|26:11.en: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying: 'He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.'

tanach-bereishit|26:12.en: And Isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundredfold; and the Lord blessed him.

tanach-bereishit|26:13.en: And the man waxed great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

tanach-bereishit|26:14.en: And he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great household; and the Philistines envied him.

tanach-bereishit|26:15.en: Now all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

tanach-bereishit|26:16.en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac: 'Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.'

tanach-bereishit|26:17.en: And Isaac departed thence, and encamped in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

tanach-bereishit|26:18.en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham; and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

tanach-bereishit|26:19.en: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of living water.

tanach-bereishit|26:20.en: And the herdmen of Gerar strove with Isaac's herdmen, saying: 'The water is ours.' And he called the name of the well Esek; because they contended with him.

tanach-bereishit|26:21.en: And they digged another well, and they strove for that also. And he called the name of it Sitnah.

tanach-bereishit|26:22.en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not. And he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said: 'For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.'

tanach-bereishit|26:23.en: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

tanach-bereishit|26:24.en: And the Lord appeared unto him the same night, and said: 'I am the God of Abraham thy father. Fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for My servant Abraham's sake.'

tanach-bereishit|26:25.en: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there; and there Isaac's servants digged a well.

tanach-bereishit|26:26.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his host.

tanach-bereishit|26:27.en: And Isaac said unto them: 'Wherefore are ye come unto me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?'

tanach-bereishit|26:28.en: And they said: 'We saw plainly that the Lord was with thee; and we said: Let there now be an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

tanach-bereishit|26:29.en: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace; thou art now the blessed of the Lord.'

tanach-bereishit|26:30.en: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

tanach-bereishit|26:31.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and swore one to another; and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

tanach-bereishit|26:32.en: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him: 'We have found water.'

tanach-bereishit|26:33.en: And he called it Shibah. Therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

tanach-bereishit|26:34.en: And when Esau was forty years old, he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

tanach-bereishit|26:35.en: And they were a bitterness of spirit unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

tanach-bereishit|27:1.en: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said unto him: 'My son'; and he said unto him: 'Here am I.'

tanach-bereishit|27:2.en: And he said: 'Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death.

tanach-bereishit|27:3.en: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison;

tanach-bereishit|27:4.en: and make me savoury food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.'

tanach-bereishit|27:5.en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

tanach-bereishit|27:6.en: And Rebekah spoke unto Jacob her son, saying: 'Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying:

tanach-bereishit|27:7.en: Bring me venison, and make me savoury food, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.

tanach-bereishit|27:8.en: Now therefore, my son, hearken to my voice according to that which I command thee.

tanach-bereishit|27:9.en: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury food for thy father, such as he loveth;

tanach-bereishit|27:10.en: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, so that he may bless thee before his death.'

tanach-bereishit|27:11.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother: 'Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

tanach-bereishit|27:12.en: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a mocker; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.'

tanach-bereishit|27:13.en: And his mother said unto him: 'Upon me be thy curse, my son; only hearken to my voice, and go fetch me them.'

tanach-bereishit|27:14.en: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother; and his mother made savoury food, such as his father loved.

tanach-bereishit|27:15.en: And Rebekah took the choicest garments of Esau her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son.

tanach-bereishit|27:16.en: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck.

tanach-bereishit|27:17.en: And she gave the savoury food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

tanach-bereishit|27:18.en: And he came unto his father, and said: 'My father'; and he said: 'Here am I; who art thou, my son?'

tanach-bereishit|27:19.en: And Jacob said unto his father: 'I am Esau thy first-born; I have done according as thou badest me. Arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.'

tanach-bereishit|27:20.en: And Isaac said unto his son: 'How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son?' And he said: 'Because the Lord thy God sent me good speed.'

tanach-bereishit|27:21.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob: 'Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.'

tanach-bereishit|27:22.en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said: 'The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.'

tanach-bereishit|27:23.en: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands; so he blessed him.

tanach-bereishit|27:24.en: And he said: 'Art thou my very son Esau?' And he said: 'I am.'

tanach-bereishit|27:25.en: And he said: 'Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee.' And he brought it near to him, and he did eat; and he brought him wine, and he drank.

tanach-bereishit|27:26.en: And his father Isaac said unto him: 'Come near now, and kiss me, my son.'

tanach-bereishit|27:27.en: And he came near, and kissed him. And he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said: See, the smell of my son Is as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed.

tanach-bereishit|27:28.en: So God give thee of the dew of heaven, And of the fat places of the earth, And plenty of corn and wine.

tanach-bereishit|27:29.en: Let peoples serve thee, And nations bow down to thee. Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother's sons bow down to thee. Cursed be every one that curseth thee, And blessed be every one that blesseth thee.

tanach-bereishit|27:30.en: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

tanach-bereishit|27:31.en: And he also made savoury food, and brought it unto his father; and he said unto his father: 'Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.'

tanach-bereishit|27:32.en: And Isaac his father said unto him: 'Who art thou?' And he said: 'I am thy son, thy first-born, Esau.'

tanach-bereishit|27:33.en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said: 'Who then is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.'

tanach-bereishit|27:34.en: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said unto his father: 'Bless me, even me also, O my father.'

tanach-bereishit|27:35.en: And he said: 'Thy brother came with guile, and hath taken away thy blessing.'

tanach-bereishit|27:36.en: And he said: 'Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing.' And he said: 'Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?'

tanach-bereishit|27:37.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau: 'Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him; and what then shall I do for thee, my son?'

tanach-bereishit|27:38.en: And Esau said unto his father: 'Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father.' And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

tanach-bereishit|27:39.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him: Behold, of the fat places of the earth shall be thy dwelling, And of the dew of heaven from above;

tanach-bereishit|27:40.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live, And thou shalt serve thy brother; And it shall come to pass when thou shalt break loose, That thou shalt shake his yoke from off thy neck.

tanach-bereishit|27:41.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him. And Esau said in his heart: 'Let the days of mourning for my father be at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.'

tanach-bereishit|27:42.en: And the words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah; and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him: 'Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

tanach-bereishit|27:43.en: Now therefore, my son, hearken to my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

tanach-bereishit|27:44.en: and tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;

tanach-bereishit|27:45.en: until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him; then I will send, and fetch thee from thence; why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?'

tanach-bereishit|27:46.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac: 'I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?'

tanach-bereishit|28:1.en: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him: 'Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

tanach-bereishit|28:2.en: Arise, go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

tanach-bereishit|28:3.en: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a congregation of peoples;

tanach-bereishit|28:4.en: and give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land of thy sojournings, which God gave unto Abraham.'

tanach-bereishit|28:5.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob; and he went to Paddan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

tanach-bereishit|28:6.en: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying: 'Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan';

tanach-bereishit|28:7.en: and that Jacob hearkened to his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan-aram;

tanach-bereishit|28:8.en: and Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

tanach-bereishit|28:9.en: so Esau went unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives that he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

tanach-bereishit|28:10.en: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

tanach-bereishit|28:11.en: And he lighted upon the place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

tanach-bereishit|28:12.en: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven; and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

tanach-bereishit|28:13.en: And, behold, the Lord stood beside him, and said: 'I am the Lord, the God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac. The land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.

tanach-bereishit|28:14.en: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. And in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

tanach-bereishit|28:15.en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee back into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.'

tanach-hoshea|11:7.en: And My people are in suspense about returning to Me; And though they call them upwards, None at all will lift himself up.

tanach-hoshea|11:8.en: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? How shall I surrender thee, Israel? How shall I make thee as Admah? How shall I set thee as Zeboim? My heart is turned within Me, My compassions are kindled together.

tanach-hoshea|11:9.en: I will not execute the fierceness of Mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim, For I am God, and not man, The Holy One in the midst of thee, And I will not come in fury.

tanach-hoshea|11:10.en: They shall walk after the Lord, Who shall roar like a lion; For He shall roar, And the children shall come trembling from the west.

tanach-hoshea|11:11.en: They shall come trembling as a bird out of Egypt, And as a dove out of the land of Assyria; And I will make them to dwell in their houses, Saith the Lord.

tanach-hoshea|12:1.en: Ephraim compasseth Me about with lies, And the house of Israel with deceit; And Judah is yet wayward towards God, And towards the Holy One who is faithful.

tanach-mishlei|6:17.en: Haughty eyes, a lying tongue, And hands that shed innocent blood;

tanach-mishlei|6:18.en: A heart that deviseth wicked thoughts, Feet that are swift in running to evil;

tanach-mishlei|6:19.en: A false witness that breatheth out lies, And he that soweth discord among brethren.

tanach-mishlei|6:20.en: My son, keep the commandment of thy father, And forsake not the teaching of thy mother;

tanach-mishlei|6:21.en: Bind them continually upon thy heart, Tie them about thy neck.

tanach-mishlei|6:22.en: When thou walkest, it shall lead thee, When thou liest down, it shall watch over thee; And when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

tanach-bereishit|28:16.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said: 'Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.'

tanach-bereishit|28:17.en: And he was afraid, and said: 'How full of awe is this place! this is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.'

tanach-bereishit|28:18.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

tanach-bereishit|28:19.en: And he called the name of that place Beth-el, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

apparatus.text: That is, The house of God.

tanach-hoshea|12:2.en: Ephraim striveth after wind, and followeth after the east wind; All the day he multiplieth lies and desolation; And they make a covenant with Assyria, And oil is carried into Egypt.

tanach-hoshea|12:3.en: The Lord hath also a controversy with Judah, And will punish Jacob according to his ways, According to his doings will He recompense him.

tanach-hoshea|12:4.en: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, And by his strength he strove with a godlike being;

tanach-hoshea|12:5.en: So he strove with an angel, and prevailed; He wept, and made supplication unto him; At Beth-el he would find him, And there he would speak with us.

tanach-mishlei|6:23.en: For the commandment is a lamp, and the teaching is light, And reproofs of instruction are the way of life;

tanach-mishlei|6:24.en: To keep thee from the evil woman, From the smoothness of the alien tongue.

tanach-mishlei|6:25.en: Lust not after her beauty in thy heart; Neither let her captivate thee with her eyelids.

tanach-mishlei|6:26.en: For on account of a harlot a man is brought to a loaf of bread, But the adulteress hunteth for the precious life.

tanach-bereishit|28:20.en: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying: 'If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

tanach-bereishit|28:21.en: so that I come back to my father's house in peace, then shall the Lord be my God,

tanach-bereishit|28:22.en: and this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God's house; and of all that Thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto Thee.'

tanach-bereishit|29:1.en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

tanach-bereishit|29:2.en: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, three flocks of sheep lying there by it.—For out of that well they watered the flocks. And the stone upon the well's mouth was great.

tanach-hoshea|12:6.en: But the Lord, the God of hosts, The Lord is His name.

tanach-hoshea|12:7.en: Therefore turn thou to thy God; Keep mercy and justice, And wait for thy God continually.

tanach-hoshea|12:8.en: As for the trafficker, the balances of deceit are in his hand, He loveth to oppress.

tanach-hoshea|12:9.en: And Ephraim said: 'Surely I am become rich, I have found me wealth; In all my labours they shall find in me No iniquity that were sin.'

tanach-hoshea|12:10.en: But I am the Lord thy God From the land of Egypt; I will yet again make thee to dwell in tents, As in the days of the appointed season.

tanach-mishlei|6:27.en: Can a man take fire in his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?

tanach-mishlei|6:28.en: Or can one walk upon hot coals, And his feet not be scorched?

tanach-mishlei|6:29.en: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; Whosoever toucheth her shall not go unpunished.

tanach-mishlei|6:30.en: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

tanach-mishlei|6:31.en: But if he be found, he must restore sevenfold, He must give all the substance of his house.

tanach-bereishit|29:3.en: And thither were all the flocks gathered; and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back upon the well's mouth in its place.—

tanach-bereishit|29:4.en: And Jacob said unto them: 'My brethren, whence are ye?' And they said: 'Of Haran are we.'

tanach-bereishit|29:5.en: And he said unto them: 'Know ye Laban the son of Nahor?' And they said: 'We know him.'

tanach-bereishit|29:6.en: And he said unto them: 'Is it well with him?' And they said: 'It is well; and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.'

tanach-bereishit|29:7.en: And he said: 'Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together; water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.'

tanach-bereishit|29:8.en: And they said: 'We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.'

tanach-hoshea|12:11.en: I have also spoken unto the prophets, And I have multiplied visions; And by the ministry of the prophets have I used similitudes.

tanach-hoshea|12:12.en: If Gilead be given to iniquity Becoming altogether vanity, In Gilgal they sacrifice unto bullocks; Yea, their altars shall be as heaps In the furrows of the field.

notes.he: בתרגום האנגלי ההיסטורי זובחים לשוורים; לפי הקריאה האחרת השוורים עצמם נזבחים.
notes.en: The historical English has “sacrifice unto bullocks.” The Hebrew also allows the reading “they sacrificed bulls.”

tanach-hoshea|12:13.en: And Jacob fled into the field of Aram, And Israel served for a wife, And for a wife he kept sheep.

tanach-hoshea|12:14.en: And by a prophet the Lord brought Israel up out of Egypt, And by a prophet was he kept.

tanach-hoshea|12:15.en: Ephraim hath provoked most bitterly; Therefore shall his blood be cast upon him, And his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

tanach-hoshea|13:1.en: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling, He exalted himself in Israel; But when he became guilty through Baal, he died.

tanach-mishlei|6:32.en: He that committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding; He doeth it that would destroy his own soul.

tanach-mishlei|6:33.en: Wounds and dishonour shall he get, And his reproach shall not be wiped away.

tanach-mishlei|6:34.en: For jealousy is the rage of a man, And he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

tanach-mishlei|6:35.en: He will not regard any ransom; Neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

tanach-mishlei|7:1.en: My son, keep my words, And lay up my commandments with thee.

tanach-mishlei|7:2.en: Keep my commandments and live, And my teaching as the apple of thine eye.

tanach-bereishit|29:9.en: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she tended them.

tanach-bereishit|29:10.en: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

tanach-bereishit|29:11.en: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

tanach-bereishit|29:12.en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son; and she ran and told her father.

tanach-bereishit|29:13.en: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

tanach-hoshea|13:2.en: And now they sin more and more, And have made them molten images of their silver, According to their own understanding, even idols, All of them the work of the craftsmen; Of them they say: 'They that sacrifice men kiss calves.'

tanach-hoshea|13:3.en: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, And as the dew that early passeth away, As the chaff that is driven with the wind out of the threshing-floor, And as the smoke out of the window.

tanach-hoshea|13:4.en: Yet I am the Lord thy God From the land of Egypt; And thou knowest no God but Me, And beside Me there is no saviour.

tanach-hoshea|13:5.en: I did know thee in the wilderness, In the land of great drought.

tanach-hoshea|13:6.en: When they were fed, they became full, They were filled, and their heart was exalted; Therefore have they forgotten Me.

tanach-mishlei|7:3.en: Bind them upon thy fingers, Write them upon the table of thy heart.

tanach-mishlei|7:4.en: Say unto wisdom: 'Thou art my sister', And call understanding thy kinswoman;

tanach-mishlei|7:5.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, From the alien woman that maketh smooth her words.

tanach-mishlei|7:6.en: For at the window of my house I looked forth through my lattice;

tanach-mishlei|7:7.en: And I beheld among the thoughtless ones, I discerned among the youths, A young man void of understanding,

tanach-bereishit|29:14.en: And Laban said to him: 'Surely thou art my bone and my flesh.' And he abode with him the space of a month.

tanach-bereishit|29:15.en: And Laban said unto Jacob: 'Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?'

tanach-bereishit|29:16.en: Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

tanach-bereishit|29:17.en: And Leah's eyes were weak; but Rachel was of beautiful form and fair to look upon.

tanach-bereishit|29:18.en: And Jacob loved Rachel; and he said: 'I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.'

tanach-bereishit|29:19.en: And Laban said: 'It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man; abide with me.'

tanach-bereishit|29:20.en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

tanach-bereishit|29:21.en: And Jacob said unto Laban: 'Give me my wife, for my days are filled, that I may go in unto her.'

tanach-bereishit|29:22.en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

tanach-bereishit|29:23.en: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

tanach-bereishit|29:24.en: And Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid unto his daughter Leah for a handmaid.

tanach-bereishit|29:25.en: And it came to pass in the morning that, behold, it was Leah; and he said to Laban: 'What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?'

tanach-bereishit|29:26.en: And Laban said: 'It is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the first-born.

tanach-bereishit|29:27.en: Fulfil the week of this one, and we will give thee the other also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.'

tanach-bereishit|29:28.en: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week; and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife.

tanach-bereishit|29:29.en: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her handmaid.

tanach-bereishit|29:30.en: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

tanach-bereishit|29:31.en: And the Lord saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.

tanach-bereishit|29:32.en: And Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she called his name Reuben; for she said: 'Because the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me.'

tanach-bereishit|29:33.en: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and said: 'Because the Lord hath heard that I am hated, He hath therefore given me this son also.' And she called his name Simeon.

tanach-bereishit|29:34.en: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and said: 'Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have borne him three sons.' Therefore was his name called Levi.

tanach-bereishit|29:35.en: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and she said: 'This time will I praise the Lord.' Therefore she called his name Judah; and she left off bearing.

tanach-bereishit|30:1.en: And when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and she said unto Jacob: 'Give me children, or else I die.'

tanach-bereishit|30:2.en: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel; and he said: 'Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?'

tanach-bereishit|30:3.en: And she said: 'Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; that she may bear upon my knees, and I also may be builded up through her.'

tanach-bereishit|30:4.en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife; and Jacob went in unto her.

tanach-bereishit|30:5.en: And Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

tanach-bereishit|30:6.en: And Rachel said: 'God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son.' Therefore called she his name Dan.

tanach-bereishit|30:7.en: And Bilhah Rachel's handmaid conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

tanach-bereishit|30:8.en: And Rachel said: 'With mighty wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed.' And she called his name Naphtali.

tanach-bereishit|30:9.en: When Leah saw that she had left off bearing, she took Zilpah her handmaid, and gave her to Jacob to wife.

tanach-bereishit|30:10.en: And Zilpah Leah's handmaid bore Jacob a son.

tanach-bereishit|30:11.en: And Leah said: 'Fortune is come!' And she called his name Gad.

tanach-bereishit|30:12.en: And Zilpah Leah's handmaid bore Jacob a second son.

tanach-bereishit|30:13.en: And Leah said: 'Happy am I! for the daughters will call me happy.' And she called his name Asher.

tanach-bereishit|30:14.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah: 'Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.'

tanach-bereishit|30:15.en: And she said unto her: 'Is it a small matter that thou hast taken away my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also?' And Rachel said: 'Therefore he shall lie with thee to-night for thy son's mandrakes.'

tanach-bereishit|30:16.en: And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said: 'Thou must come in unto me; for I have surely hired thee with my son's mandrakes.' And he lay with her that night.

tanach-bereishit|30:17.en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

tanach-bereishit|30:18.en: And Leah said: 'God hath given me my hire, because I gave my handmaid to my husband. And she called his name Issachar.

tanach-bereishit|30:19.en: And Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

tanach-bereishit|30:20.en: And Leah said: 'God hath endowed me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons.' And she called his name Zebulun.

tanach-bereishit|30:21.en: And afterwards she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

tanach-bereishit|30:22.en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

tanach-bereishit|30:23.en: And she conceived, and bore a son, and said: 'God hath taken away my reproach.'

tanach-bereishit|30:24.en: And she called his name Joseph, saying: 'The Lord add to me another son.'

tanach-bereishit|30:25.en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban: 'Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

tanach-bereishit|30:26.en: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served thee, and let me go; for thou knowest my service wherewith I have served thee.'

tanach-bereishit|30:27.en: And Laban said unto him: 'If now I have found favour in thine eyes—I have observed the signs, and the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.'

tanach-bereishit|30:28.en: And he said: 'Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.'

tanach-bereishit|30:29.en: And he said unto him: 'Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle have fared with me.

tanach-bereishit|30:30.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it hath increased abundantly; and the Lord hath blessed thee whithersoever I turned. And now when shall I provide for mine own house also?'

tanach-bereishit|30:31.en: And he said: 'What shall I give thee?' And Jacob said: 'Thou shalt not give me aught; if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed thy flock and keep it.

tanach-bereishit|30:32.en: I will pass through all thy flock to-day, removing from thence every speckled and spotted one, and every dark one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats; and of such shall be my hire.

tanach-bereishit|30:33.en: So shall my righteousness witness against me hereafter, when thou shalt come to look over my hire that is before thee: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and dark among the sheep, that if found with me shall be counted stolen.'

tanach-bereishit|30:34.en: And Laban said: 'Behold, would it might be according to thy word.'

tanach-bereishit|30:35.en: And he removed that day the he-goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the dark ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

tanach-bereishit|30:36.en: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob. And Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

tanach-bereishit|30:37.en: And Jacob took him rods of fresh poplar, and of the almond and of the plane-tree; and peeled white streaks in them, making the white appear which was in the rods.

tanach-bereishit|30:38.en: And he set the rods which he had peeled over against the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink; and they conceived when they came to drink.

tanach-bereishit|30:39.en: And the flocks conceived at the sight of the rods, and the flocks brought forth streaked, speckled, and spotted.

tanach-bereishit|30:40.en: And Jacob separated the lambs—he also set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the dark in the flock of Laban— and put his own droves apart, and put them not unto Laban's flock.

tanach-bereishit|30:41.en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger of the flock did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;

tanach-bereishit|30:42.en: but when the flock were feeble, he put them not in; so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

tanach-bereishit|30:43.en: And the man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, and maid-servants and men-servants, and camels and asses.

tanach-bereishit|31:1.en: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying: 'Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this wealth.'

tanach-bereishit|31:2.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as beforetime.

tanach-bereishit|31:3.en: And the Lord said unto Jacob: 'Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.'

tanach-bereishit|31:4.en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

tanach-bereishit|31:5.en: and said unto them: 'I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as beforetime; but the God of my father hath been with me.

tanach-bereishit|31:6.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

tanach-bereishit|31:7.en: And your father hath mocked me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

tanach-bereishit|31:8.en: If he said thus: The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the flock bore speckled; and if he said thus: The streaked shall be thy wages; then bore all the flock streaked.

tanach-bereishit|31:9.en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

tanach-bereishit|31:10.en: And it came to pass at the time that the flock conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the he-goats which leaped upon the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

tanach-bereishit|31:11.en: And the angel of God said unto me in the dream: Jacob; and I said: Here am I.

tanach-bereishit|31:12.en: And he said: Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the he-goats which leap upon the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled; for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

tanach-bereishit|31:13.en: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou didst anoint a pillar, where thou didst vow a vow unto Me. Now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy nativity.'

tanach-bereishit|31:14.en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him: 'Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

tanach-bereishit|31:15.en: Are we not accounted by him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath also quite devoured our price.

tanach-bereishit|31:16.en: For all the riches which God hath taken away from our father, that is ours and our children's. Now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.'

tanach-bereishit|31:17.en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon the camels;

tanach-bereishit|31:18.en: and he carried away all his cattle, and all his substance which he had gathered, the cattle of his getting, which he had gathered in Paddan-aram, to go to Isaac his father unto the land of Canaan.

tanach-bereishit|31:19.en: Now Laban was gone to shear his sheep. And Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father's.

tanach-bereishit|31:20.en: And Jacob outwitted Laban the Aramean, in that he told him not that he fled.

tanach-bereishit|31:21.en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

tanach-bereishit|31:22.en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

tanach-bereishit|31:23.en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and he overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

tanach-bereishit|31:24.en: And God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream of the night, and said unto him: 'Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.'

tanach-bereishit|31:25.en: And Laban came up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain; and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mountain of Gilead.

tanach-bereishit|31:26.en: And Laban said to Jacob: 'What hast thou done, that thou hast outwitted me, and carried away my daughters as though captives of the sword?

tanach-bereishit|31:27.en: Wherefore didst thou flee secretly, and outwit me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth and with songs, with tabret and with harp;

tanach-bereishit|31:28.en: and didst not suffer me to kiss my sons and my daughters? now hast thou done foolishly.

tanach-bereishit|31:29.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt; but the God of your father spoke unto me yesternight, saying: Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

tanach-bereishit|31:30.en: And now that thou art surely gone, because thou sore longest after thy father's house, wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?'

tanach-bereishit|31:31.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban: 'Because I was afraid; for I said: Lest thou shouldest take thy daughters from me by force.

tanach-bereishit|31:32.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, he shall not live; before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee.'— For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.—

tanach-bereishit|31:33.en: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the tent of the two maid-servants; but he found them not. And he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

tanach-bereishit|31:34.en: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, and put them in the saddle of the camel, and sat upon them. And Laban felt about all the tent, but found them not.

tanach-bereishit|31:35.en: And she said to her father: 'Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise up before thee; for the manner of women is upon me.' And he searched, but found not the teraphim.

tanach-bereishit|31:36.en: And Jacob was wroth, and strove with Laban. And Jacob answered and said to Laban: 'What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast hotly pursued after me?

tanach-bereishit|31:37.en: Whereas thou hast felt about all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? Set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us two.

tanach-bereishit|31:38.en: These twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flocks have I not eaten.

tanach-bereishit|31:39.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bore the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

tanach-bereishit|31:40.en: Thus I was: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.

tanach-bereishit|31:41.en: These twenty years have I been in thy house: I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy flock; and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

tanach-bereishit|31:42.en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac, had been on my side, surely now hadst thou sent me away empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and gave judgment yesternight.'

tanach-bereishit|31:43.en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob: 'The daughters are my daughters, and the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks, and all that thou seest is mine; and what can I do this day for these my daughters, or for their children whom they have borne?

tanach-bereishit|31:44.en: And now come, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.'

tanach-bereishit|31:45.en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

tanach-bereishit|31:46.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren: 'Gather stones'; and they took stones, and made a heap. And they did eat there by the heap.

tanach-bereishit|31:47.en: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha; but Jacob called it Galeed.

apparatus.text: That is, The heap of witness, in Aramaic.
That is, The heap of witness, in Hebrew.

tanach-bereishit|31:48.en: And Laban said: 'This heap is witness between me and thee this day.' Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

tanach-bereishit|31:49.en: and Mizpah, for he said: 'The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

tanach-bereishit|31:50.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, and if thou shalt take wives beside my daughters, no man being with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.'

tanach-bereishit|31:51.en: And Laban said to Jacob: 'Behold this heap, and behold the pillar, which I have set up betwixt me and thee.

tanach-bereishit|31:52.en: This heap be witness, and the pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

tanach-bereishit|31:53.en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us.' And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.

tanach-bereishit|31:54.en: And Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread; and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mountain.

tanach-bereishit|32:1.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. And Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

tanach-bereishit|32:2.en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

tanach-bereishit|32:3.en: And Jacob said when he saw them: 'This is God's camp.' And he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

tanach-bereishit|32:4.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

tanach-bereishit|32:5.en: And he commanded them, saying: 'Thus shall ye say unto my lord Esau: Thus saith thy servant Jacob: I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed until now.

tanach-bereishit|32:6.en: And I have oxen, and asses and flocks, and men-servants and maid-servants; and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favour in thy sight.'

tanach-bereishit|32:7.en: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying: 'We came to thy brother Esau, and moreover he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.'

tanach-bereishit|32:8.en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. And he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two camps.

tanach-bereishit|32:9.en: And he said: 'If Esau come to the one camp, and smite it, then the camp which is left shall escape.'

tanach-ovadya|1:1.en: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom: We have heard a message from the Lord, And an ambassador is sent among the nations: 'Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.'

tanach-ovadya|1:2.en: Behold, I make thee small among the nations; Thou art greatly despised.

tanach-ovadya|1:3.en: The pride of thy heart hath beguiled thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, Thy habitation on high; That sayest in thy heart. 'Who shall bring me down to the ground?'

tanach-ovadya|1:4.en: Though thou make thy nest as high as the eagle, And though thou set it among the stars, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.

tanach-ovadya|1:5.en: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night— How art thou cut off!— Would they not steal till they had enough? If grape-gatherers came to thee, Would they not leave some gleaning grapes?

tanach-ovadya|1:6.en: How is Esau searched out! How are his hidden places sought out!

tanach-mishlei|7:8.en: Passing through the street near her corner, And he went the way to her house;

tanach-mishlei|7:9.en: In the twilight, in the evening of the day, In the blackness of night and the darkness.

tanach-mishlei|7:10.en: And, behold, there met him a woman With the attire of a harlot, and wily of heart.

tanach-mishlei|7:11.en: She is riotous and rebellious, Her feet abide not in her house;

tanach-mishlei|7:12.en: Now she is in the streets, now in the broad places, And lieth in wait at every corner.

tanach-mishlei|7:13.en: So she caught him, and kissed him, And with an impudent face she said unto him:

tanach-bereishit|32:10.en: And Jacob said: 'O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, O Lord, who saidst unto me: Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will do thee good;

tanach-bereishit|32:11.en: I am not worthy of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which Thou hast shown unto Thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two camps.

tanach-bereishit|32:12.en: Deliver me, I pray Thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.

tanach-bereishit|32:13.en: And Thou saidst: I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.'

tanach-ovadya|1:7.en: All the men of thy confederacy Have conducted thee to the border; The men that were at peace with thee Have beguiled thee, and prevailed against thee; They that eat thy bread lay a snare under thee, In whom there is no discernment.

tanach-ovadya|1:8.en: Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, Destroy the wise men out of Edom, And discernment out of the mount of Esau?

tanach-ovadya|1:9.en: And thy mighty men, Teman, shall be dismayed, To the end that every one may be cut off from the mount of Esau by slaughter,

tanach-ovadya|1:10.en: For the violence done to thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, And thou shalt be cut off for ever.

tanach-mishlei|7:14.en: 'Sacrifices of peace-offerings were due from me; This day have I paid my vows.

tanach-mishlei|7:15.en: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, To seek thy face, and I have found thee.

tanach-mishlei|7:16.en: I have decked my couch with coverlets, With striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

tanach-mishlei|7:17.en: I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

tanach-bereishit|32:14.en: And he lodged there that night; and took of that which he had with him a present for Esau his brother:

tanach-bereishit|32:15.en: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

tanach-bereishit|32:16.en: thirty milch camels and their colts, forty kine and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten foals.

tanach-bereishit|32:17.en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself; and said unto his servants: 'Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.'

tanach-bereishit|32:18.en: And he commanded the foremost, saying: 'When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying: Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

tanach-ovadya|1:11.en: In the day that thou didst stand aloof, In the day that strangers carried away his substance, And foreigners entered into his gates, And cast lots upon Jerusalem, Even thou wast as one of them.

tanach-ovadya|1:12.en: But thou shouldest not have gazed on the day of thy brother In the day of his disaster, Neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah In the day of their destruction; Neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly In the day of distress.

tanach-ovadya|1:13.en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of My people In the day of their calamity; Yea, thou shouldest not have gazed on their affliction In the day of their calamity, Nor have laid hands on their substance In the day of their calamity.

tanach-ovadya|1:14.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, To cut off those of his that escape; Neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his That did remain in the day of distress.

tanach-ovadya|1:15.en: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the nations; As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; Thy dealing shall return upon thine own head.

tanach-mishlei|7:18.en: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; Let us solace ourselves with loves.

tanach-mishlei|7:19.en: For my husband is not at home, He is gone a long journey;

tanach-mishlei|7:20.en: He hath taken the bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.'

tanach-mishlei|7:21.en: With her much fair speech she causeth him to yield, With the blandishment of her lips she enticeth him away.

tanach-mishlei|7:22.en: He goeth after her straightway, As an ox that goeth to the slaughter, Or as one in fetters to the correction of the fool;

tanach-bereishit|32:19.en: then thou shalt say: They are thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord, even unto Esau; and, behold, he also is behind us.'

tanach-bereishit|32:20.en: And he commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying: 'In this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him;

tanach-bereishit|32:21.en: and ye shall say: Moreover, behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us.' For he said: 'I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept me.'

tanach-bereishit|32:22.en: So the present passed over before him; and he himself lodged that night in the camp.

tanach-bereishit|32:23.en: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two handmaids, and his eleven children, and passed over the ford of the Jabbok.

tanach-bereishit|32:24.en: And he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

tanach-ovadya|1:16.en: For as ye have drunk upon My holy mountain, So shall all the nations drink continually, Yea, they shall drink, and swallow down. And shall be as though they had not been.

tanach-ovadya|1:17.en: But in mount Zion there shall be those that escape, And it shall be holy; And the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

tanach-ovadya|1:18.en: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, And the house of Joseph a flame, And the house of Esau for stubble, And they shall kindle in them, and devour them; And there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; For the Lord hath spoken.

tanach-ovadya|1:19.en: And they of the South shall posses the mount of Esau, And they of the Lowland the Philistines; And they shall possess the field of Ephraim, And the field of Samaria; And Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

tanach-ovadya|1:20.en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel, That are among the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath, And the captivity of Jerusalem, that is in Sepharad, Shall posses the cities of the South.

tanach-ovadya|1:21.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion To judge the mount of Esau; And the kingdom shall be the Lord's.

tanach-mishlei|7:23.en: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteneth to the snare— And knoweth not that it is at the cost of his life.

tanach-mishlei|7:24.en: Now therefore, O ye children, hearken unto me, And attend to the words of my mouth.

tanach-mishlei|7:25.en: Let not thy heart decline to her ways, Go not astray in her paths.

tanach-mishlei|7:26.en: For she hath cast down many wounded; Yea, a mighty host are all her slain.

tanach-mishlei|7:27.en: Her house is the way to the nether-world, Going down to the chambers of death.

tanach-mishlei|8:1.en: Doth not wisdom call, And understanding put forth her voice?

tanach-bereishit|32:25.en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

tanach-bereishit|32:26.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was strained, as he wrestled with him.

tanach-bereishit|32:27.en: And he said: 'Let me go, for the day breaketh.' And he said: 'I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.'

tanach-bereishit|32:28.en: And he said unto him: 'What is thy name?' And he said: 'Jacob.'

tanach-bereishit|32:29.en: And he said: 'Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel; for thou hast striven with God and with men, and hast prevailed.'

apparatus.text: That is, He who striveth with God.

tanach-yonah|1:1.en: Now the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying:

tanach-yonah|1:2.en: 'Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and proclaim against it; For their wickedness is come up before Me.'

tanach-yonah|1:3.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord; and he went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish, from the presence of the Lord.

tanach-yonah|1:4.en: But the Lord hurled a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

tanach-yonah|1:5.en: And the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god; and they cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it unto them. But Jonah was gone down into the innermost parts of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

tanach-mishlei|8:2.en: In the top of high places by the way, Where the paths meet, she standeth;

tanach-mishlei|8:3.en: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, At the coming in at the doors, she crieth aloud:

tanach-mishlei|8:4.en: 'Unto you, O men, I call, And my voice is to the sons of men.

tanach-mishlei|8:5.en: O ye thoughtless, understand prudence, And, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

tanach-mishlei|8:6.en: Hear, for I will speak excellent things, And the opening of my lips shall be right things.

tanach-bereishit|32:30.en: And Jacob asked him, and said: 'Tell me, I pray thee, thy name.' And he said: 'Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name?' And he blessed him there.

tanach-bereishit|32:31.en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: 'for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.'

apparatus.text: That is, The face of God.

tanach-bereishit|32:32.en: And the sun rose upon him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped upon his thigh.

tanach-bereishit|32:33.en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not the sinew of the thigh-vein which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day; because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh, even in the sinew of the thigh-vein.

tanach-bereishit|33:1.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

tanach-bereishit|33:2.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

tanach-bereishit|33:3.en: And he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

tanach-bereishit|33:4.en: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they wept.

tanach-bereishit|33:5.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said: 'Who are these with thee?' And he said: 'The children whom God hath graciously given thy servant.'

tanach-bereishit|33:6.en: Then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed down.

tanach-bereishit|33:7.en: And Leah also and her children came near, and bowed down; and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed down.

tanach-bereishit|33:8.en: And he said: 'What meanest thou by all this camp which I met?' And he said: 'To find favour in the sight of my lord.'

tanach-bereishit|33:9.en: And Esau said: 'I have enough; my brother, let that which thou hast be thine.'

tanach-bereishit|33:10.en: And Jacob said: 'Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found favour in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand; forasmuch as I have seen thy face, as one seeth the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

tanach-bereishit|33:11.en: Take, I pray thee, my gift that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.' And he urged him, and he took it.

tanach-bereishit|33:12.en: And he said: 'Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.'

tanach-bereishit|33:13.en: And he said unto him: 'My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds giving suck are a care to me; and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

tanach-bereishit|33:14.en: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant; and I will journey on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.'

tanach-bereishit|33:15.en: And Esau said: 'Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me.' And he said: 'What needeth it? let me find favour in the sight of my lord.'

tanach-bereishit|33:16.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

tanach-bereishit|33:17.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

tanach-bereishit|33:18.en: And Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram; and encamped before the city.

tanach-bereishit|33:19.en: And he bought the parcel of ground, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of money.

tanach-bereishit|33:20.en: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.

apparatus.text: That is, God, the God of Israel.

tanach-bereishit|34:1.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

tanach-bereishit|34:2.en: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; and he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.

tanach-bereishit|34:3.en: And his soul did cleave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spoke comfortingly unto the damsel.

tanach-bereishit|34:4.en: And Shechem spoke unto his father Hamor, saying: 'Get me this damsel to wife.'

tanach-bereishit|34:5.en: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field; and Jacob held his peace until they came.

tanach-bereishit|34:6.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to speak with him.

tanach-bereishit|34:7.en: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it; and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought a vile deed in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

tanach-bereishit|34:8.en: And Hamor spoke with them, saying 'The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter. I pray you give her unto him to wife.

tanach-bereishit|34:9.en: And make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

tanach-bereishit|34:10.en: And ye shall dwell with us; and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.'

tanach-bereishit|34:11.en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren: 'Let me find favour in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

tanach-bereishit|34:12.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me; but give me the damsel to wife.'

tanach-bereishit|34:13.en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile, and spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

tanach-bereishit|34:14.en: and said unto them: 'We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.

tanach-bereishit|34:15.en: Only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;

tanach-bereishit|34:16.en: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

tanach-bereishit|34:17.en: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.'

tanach-bereishit|34:18.en: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

tanach-bereishit|34:19.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter. And he was honoured above all the house of his father.

tanach-bereishit|34:20.en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying:

tanach-bereishit|34:21.en: 'These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for, behold, the land is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

tanach-bereishit|34:22.en: Only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

tanach-bereishit|34:23.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and all their beasts be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.'

tanach-bereishit|34:24.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

tanach-bereishit|34:25.en: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unawares, and slew all the males.

tanach-bereishit|34:26.en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went forth.

tanach-bereishit|34:27.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

tanach-bereishit|34:28.en: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses, and that which was in the city and that which was in the field;
