tanach-bereishit|34:29.en: and all their wealth, and all their little ones and their wives, took they captive and spoiled, even all that was in the house.

tanach-bereishit|34:30.en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi: 'Ye have troubled me, to make me odious unto the inhabitants of the land, even unto the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and, I being few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and smite me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.'

tanach-bereishit|34:31.en: And they said: 'Should one deal with our sister as with a harlot?'

tanach-bereishit|35:1.en: And God said unto Jacob: 'Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there; and make there an altar unto God, who appeared unto thee when thou didst flee from the face of Esau thy brother.'

tanach-bereishit|35:2.en: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him: 'Put away the strange gods that are among you, and purify yourselves, and change your garments;

tanach-bereishit|35:3.en: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.'

tanach-bereishit|35:4.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth which was by Shechem.

tanach-bereishit|35:5.en: And they journeyed; and a terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

tanach-bereishit|35:6.en: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan—the same is Beth-el—he and all the people that were with him.

tanach-bereishit|35:7.en: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el, because there God was revealed unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

apparatus.text: That is, The God of Beth-el.

tanach-bereishit|35:8.en: And Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried below Beth-el under the oak; and the name of it was called Allon-bacuth.

apparatus.text: That is, The oak of weeping.

tanach-bereishit|35:9.en: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.

tanach-bereishit|35:10.en: And God said unto him: 'Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name'; and He called his name Israel.

tanach-bereishit|35:11.en: And God said unto him: 'I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

tanach-bereishit|35:12.en: and the land which I gave unto Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.'

tanach-bereishit|35:13.en: And God went up from him in the place where He spoke with him.

tanach-bereishit|35:14.en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He spoke with him, a pillar of stone, and he poured out a drink-offering thereon, and poured oil thereon.

tanach-bereishit|35:15.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Beth-el.

tanach-bereishit|35:16.en: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was still some way to come to Ephrath; and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

tanach-bereishit|35:17.en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her: 'Fear not; for this also is a son for thee.'

tanach-bereishit|35:18.en: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing—for she died—that she called his name Ben-oni; but his father called him Benjamin.

apparatus.text: That is, The son of my sorrow.
That is, The son of the right hand.

tanach-bereishit|35:19.en: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath—the same is Beth-lehem.

tanach-bereishit|35:20.en: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave; the same is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.

tanach-bereishit|35:21.en: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond Migdal-eder.

tanach-bereishit|35:22.en: And it came to pass, while Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine; and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

tanach-bereishit|35:23.en: the sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first-born, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun;

tanach-bereishit|35:24.en: the sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;

tanach-bereishit|35:25.en: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid: Dan and Naphtali;

tanach-bereishit|35:26.en: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Paddan-aram.

tanach-bereishit|35:27.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father to Mamre, to Kiriath-arba—the same is Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

tanach-bereishit|35:28.en: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and fourscore years.

tanach-bereishit|35:29.en: And Isaac expired, and died, and was gathered unto his people, old and full of days; and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.

tanach-bereishit|36:1.en: Now these are the generations of Esau—the same is Edom.

tanach-bereishit|36:2.en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

tanach-bereishit|36:3.en: and Basemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

tanach-bereishit|36:4.en: And Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz; and Basemath bore Reuel;

tanach-bereishit|36:5.en: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, that were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

tanach-bereishit|36:6.en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan; and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

tanach-bereishit|36:7.en: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojournings could not bear them because of their cattle.

tanach-bereishit|36:8.en: And Esau dwelt in the mountain-land of Seir—Esau is Edom.

tanach-bereishit|36:9.en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the mountain-land of Seir.

tanach-bereishit|36:10.en: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.

tanach-bereishit|36:11.en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

tanach-bereishit|36:12.en: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

tanach-bereishit|36:13.en: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath Esau's wife.

tanach-bereishit|36:14.en: And these were the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife; and she bore to Esau Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.

tanach-bereishit|36:15.en: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the first-born of Esau: the chief of Teman, the chief of Omar, the chief of Zepho, the chief of Kenaz,

tanach-bereishit|36:16.en: the chief of Korah, the chief of Gatam, the chief of Amalek. These are the chiefs that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

tanach-bereishit|36:17.en: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son: the chief of Nahath, the chief of Zerah, the chief of Shammah, the chief of Mizzah. These are the chiefs that came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath Esau's wife.

tanach-bereishit|36:18.en: And these are the sons of Oholibamah Esau's wife: the chief of Jeush, the chief of Jalam, the chief of Korah. These are the chiefs that came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

tanach-bereishit|36:19.en: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs; the same is Edom.

tanach-bereishit|36:20.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah,

tanach-bereishit|36:21.en: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan. These are the chiefs that came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

tanach-bereishit|36:22.en: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

tanach-bereishit|36:23.en: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

tanach-bereishit|36:24.en: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah—this is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

tanach-bereishit|36:25.en: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.

tanach-bereishit|36:26.en: And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.

tanach-bereishit|36:27.en: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan.

tanach-bereishit|36:28.en: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

tanach-bereishit|36:29.en: These are the chiefs that came of the Horites: the chief of Lotan, the chief of Shobal, the chief of Zibeon, the chief of Anah,

tanach-bereishit|36:30.en: the chief of Dishon, the chief of Ezer, the chief of Dishan. These are the chiefs that came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

tanach-bereishit|36:31.en: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

tanach-bereishit|36:32.en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

tanach-bereishit|36:33.en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

tanach-bereishit|36:34.en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

tanach-bereishit|36:35.en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.

tanach-bereishit|36:36.en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

tanach-bereishit|36:37.en: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.

tanach-bereishit|36:38.en: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

tanach-bereishit|36:39.en: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead; and the name of the city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

tanach-bereishit|36:40.en: And these are the names of the chiefs that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: the chief of Timna, the chief of Alvah, the chief of Jetheth;

tanach-bereishit|36:41.en: the chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon;

tanach-bereishit|36:42.en: the chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar;

tanach-bereishit|36:43.en: the chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau the father of the Edomites.

tanach-bereishit|37:1.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land of his father's sojournings, in the land of Canaan.

tanach-bereishit|37:2.en: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren, being still a lad even with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives; and Joseph brought evil report of them unto their father.

tanach-bereishit|37:3.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age; and he made him a coat of many colours.

tanach-bereishit|37:4.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

tanach-bereishit|37:5.en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brethren; and they hated him yet the more.

tanach-bereishit|37:6.en: And he said unto them: 'Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

tanach-amos|2:6.en: Thus saith the Lord: For three transgressions, of Israel, Yea, for four, I will not reverse it: Because they sell the righteous for silver, And the needy for a pair of shoes;

tanach-amos|2:7.en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, And turn aside the way of the humble; And a man and his father go unto the same maid, To profane My holy name;

tanach-amos|2:8.en: And they lay themselves down beside every altar Upon clothes taken in pledge, And in the house of their God they drink The wine of them that have been fined.

tanach-amos|2:9.en: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, Whose height was like the height of the cedars, And he was strong as the oaks; Yet I destroyed his fruit from above, And his roots from beneath.

tanach-amos|2:10.en: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, And led you forty years in the wilderness, To possess the land of the Amorite.

tanach-amos|2:11.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, And of your young men for Nazirites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? Saith the Lord.

tanach-mishlei|8:7.en: For my mouth shall utter truth, And wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

tanach-mishlei|8:8.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness, There is nothing perverse or crooked in them.

tanach-mishlei|8:9.en: They are all plain to him that understandeth, And right to them that find knowledge.

tanach-mishlei|8:10.en: Receive my instruction, and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold.

tanach-mishlei|8:11.en: For wisdom is better than rubies, And all things desirable are not to be compared unto her.

tanach-mishlei|8:12.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence, And find out knowledge of devices.

tanach-bereishit|37:7.en: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves came round about, and bowed down to my sheaf.'

tanach-bereishit|37:8.en: And his brethren said to him: 'Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us?' And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

tanach-bereishit|37:9.en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said: 'Behold, I have dreamed yet a dream: and, behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.'

tanach-bereishit|37:10.en: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren; and his father rebuked him, and said unto him: 'What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down to thee to the earth?'

tanach-amos|2:12.en: But ye gave the Nazirites wine to drink; And commanded the prophets, saying: 'Prophesy not.'

tanach-amos|2:13.en: Behold, I will make it creak under you, As a cart creaketh that is full of sheaves.

tanach-amos|2:14.en: And flight shall fail the swift, And the strong shall not exert his strength, Neither shall the mighty deliver himself;

tanach-amos|2:15.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; And he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself; Neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself;

tanach-mishlei|8:13.en: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil; Pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, And the froward mouth, do I hate.

tanach-mishlei|8:14.en: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom; I am understanding, power is mine.

tanach-mishlei|8:15.en: By me kings reign, And princes decree justice.

tanach-mishlei|8:16.en: By me princes rule, And nobles, even all the judges of righteousness.

notes.he: ״שפטי צדק״ משמעו שופטים בצדק. בתרגום האנגלי ההיסטורי נאמר ״כל שופטי הארץ״.
notes.en: שפטי צדק means “judges of righteousness”; the historical English instead reads “all the judges of the earth.”

tanach-bereishit|37:11.en: And his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying in mind.

tanach-bereishit|37:12.en: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

tanach-bereishit|37:13.en: And Israel said unto Joseph: 'Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them.' And he said to him: 'Here am I.'

tanach-bereishit|37:14.en: And he said to him: 'Go now, see whether it is well with thy brethren, and well with the flock; and bring me back word.' So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

tanach-bereishit|37:15.en: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying: 'What seekest thou?'

tanach-amos|2:16.en: And he that is courageous among the mighty Shall flee away naked in that day, Saith the Lord.

tanach-amos|3:1.en: Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:

tanach-amos|3:2.en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth; Therefore I will visit upon you all your iniquities.

tanach-amos|3:3.en: Will two walk together, Except they have agreed?

tanach-amos|3:4.en: Will a lion roar in the forest, When he hath no prey? Will a young lion give forth his voice out of his den, If he have taken nothing?

tanach-mishlei|8:17.en: I love them that love me, And those that seek me earnestly shall find me.

tanach-mishlei|8:18.en: Riches and honour are with me; Yea, enduring riches and righteousness.

tanach-mishlei|8:19.en: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my produce than choice silver.

tanach-mishlei|8:20.en: I walk in the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice;

tanach-mishlei|8:21.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance, And that I may fill their treasuries.

tanach-bereishit|37:16.en: And he said: 'I seek my brethren. Tell me, I pray thee, where they are feeding the flock.'

tanach-bereishit|37:17.en: And the man said: 'They are departed hence; for I heard them say: Let us go to Dothan.' And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

tanach-bereishit|37:18.en: And they saw him afar off, and before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

tanach-bereishit|37:19.en: And they said one to another: 'Behold, this dreamer cometh.

tanach-bereishit|37:20.en: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say: An evil beast hath devoured him; and we shall see what will become of his dreams.'

tanach-bereishit|37:21.en: And Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand; and said: 'Let us not take his life.'

tanach-amos|3:5.en: Will a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, Where there is no lure for it? Will a snare spring up from the ground, And have taken nothing at all?

tanach-amos|3:6.en: Shall the horn be blown in a city, And the people not tremble? Shall evil befall a city, And the Lord hath not done it?

tanach-amos|3:7.en: For the Lord God will do nothing, But He revealeth His counsel unto His servants the prophets.

tanach-amos|3:8.en: The lion hath roared, Who will not fear? The Lord God hath spoken, Who can but prophesy?

tanach-amos|3:9.en: Proclaim it upon the palaces at Ashdod, And upon the palaces in the land of Egypt, And say: 'Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, And behold the great confusions therein, And the oppressions in the midst thereof.'

tanach-amos|3:10.en: For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, Who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

tanach-mishlei|8:22.en: The Lord made me as the beginning of His way, The first of His works of old.

tanach-mishlei|8:23.en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, Or ever the earth was.

tanach-mishlei|8:24.en: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; When there were no fountains abounding with water.

tanach-mishlei|8:25.en: Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills was I brought forth;

tanach-mishlei|8:26.en: While as yet He had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

tanach-mishlei|8:27.en: When He established the heavens, I was there; When He set a circle upon the face of the deep,

tanach-bereishit|37:22.en: And Reuben said unto them: 'Shed no blood; cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand upon him'—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

tanach-bereishit|37:23.en: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of his coat, the coat of many colours that was on him;

tanach-bereishit|37:24.en: and they took him, and cast him into the pit—and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

tanach-bereishit|37:25.en: And they sat down to eat bread; and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a caravan of Ishmaelites came from Gilead, with their camels bearing spicery and balm and ladanum, going to carry it down to Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|37:26.en: And Judah said unto his brethren: 'What profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood?

tanach-amos|3:11.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord God: An adversary, even round about the land! And he shall bring down thy strength from thee, And thy palaces shall be spoiled.

tanach-amos|3:12.en: Thus saith the Lord: As the shepherd rescueth out of the mouth of the lion Two legs, or a piece of an ear, So shall the children of Israel that dwell in Samaria Escape with the corner of a couch, and the leg of a bed.

tanach-amos|3:13.en: Hear ye, and testify against the house of Jacob, Saith the Lord God, the God of hosts.

tanach-amos|3:14.en: For in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, I will also punish the altars of Beth-el, And the horns of the altar shall be cut off, And fall to the ground.

tanach-amos|3:15.en: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; And the houses of ivory shall perish, And the great houses shall have an end, Saith the Lord.

tanach-mishlei|8:28.en: When He made firm the skies above, When the fountains of the deep showed their might,

tanach-mishlei|8:29.en: When He gave to the sea His decree, That the waters should not transgress His commandment, When He appointed the foundations of the earth;

tanach-mishlei|8:30.en: Then I was by Him, as a nursling; And I was daily all delight, Playing always before Him,

tanach-mishlei|8:31.en: Playing in His habitable earth, And my delights are with the sons of men.

tanach-mishlei|8:32.en: Now therefore, ye children, hearken unto me; For happy are they that keep my ways.

tanach-bereishit|37:27.en: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother, our flesh.' And his brethren hearkened unto him.

tanach-bereishit|37:28.en: And there passed by Midianites, merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. And they brought Joseph into Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|37:29.en: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

tanach-bereishit|37:30.en: And he returned unto his brethren, and said: 'The child is not; and as for me, whither shall I go?'

tanach-bereishit|37:31.en: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a he-goat, and dipped the coat in the blood;

tanach-bereishit|37:32.en: and they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said: 'This have we found. Know now whether it is thy son's coat or not.'

tanach-bereishit|37:33.en: And he knew it, and said: 'It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.'

tanach-bereishit|37:34.en: And Jacob rent his garments, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

tanach-bereishit|37:35.en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said: 'Nay, but I will go down to the grave to my son mourning.' And his father wept for him.

tanach-bereishit|37:36.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard.

tanach-bereishit|38:1.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

tanach-bereishit|38:2.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; and he took her, and went in unto her.

tanach-bereishit|38:3.en: And she conceived, and bore a son; and he called his name Er.

tanach-bereishit|38:4.en: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and she called his name Onan.

tanach-bereishit|38:5.en: And she yet again bore a son, and called his name Shelah; and he was at Chezib, when she bore him.

tanach-bereishit|38:6.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, and her name was Tamar.

tanach-bereishit|38:7.en: And Er, Judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord slew him.

tanach-bereishit|38:8.en: And Judah said unto Onan: 'Go in unto thy brother's wife, and perform the duty of a husband's brother unto her, and raise up seed to thy brother.'

tanach-bereishit|38:9.en: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his; and it came to pass when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.

tanach-bereishit|38:10.en: And the thing which he did was evil in the sight of the Lord; and He slew him also.

tanach-bereishit|38:11.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter-in-law: 'Remain a widow in thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown up'; for he said: 'Lest he also die, like his brethren.' And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.

tanach-bereishit|38:12.en: And in process of time Shua's daughter, the wife of Judah, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheep-shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

tanach-bereishit|38:13.en: And it was told Tamar, saying: 'Behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.'

tanach-bereishit|38:14.en: And she put off from her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the entrance of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she was not given unto him to wife.

tanach-bereishit|38:15.en: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; for she had covered her face.

tanach-bereishit|38:16.en: And he turned unto her by the way, and said: 'Come, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee'; for he knew not that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said: 'What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?'

tanach-bereishit|38:17.en: And he said: 'I will send thee a kid of the goats from the flock.' And she said: 'Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?'

tanach-bereishit|38:18.en: And he said: 'What pledge shall I give thee?' And she said: 'Thy signet and thy cord, and thy staff that is in thy hand.' And he gave them to her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

tanach-bereishit|38:19.en: And she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

tanach-bereishit|38:20.en: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman's hand; but he found her not.

tanach-bereishit|38:21.en: Then he asked the men of her place, saying: 'Where is the harlot, that was at Enaim by the wayside?' And they said: 'There hath been no harlot here.'

tanach-bereishit|38:22.en: And he returned to Judah, and said: 'I have not found her; and also the men of the place said: There hath been no harlot here.'

tanach-bereishit|38:23.en: And Judah said: 'Let her take it, lest we be put to shame; behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.'

tanach-bereishit|38:24.en: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying: 'Tamar thy daughter-in-law hath played the harlot; and moreover, behold, she is with child by harlotry.' And Judah said: 'Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.'

tanach-bereishit|38:25.en: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying: 'By the man, whose these are, am I with child'; and she said: 'Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and the cords, and the staff.'

tanach-bereishit|38:26.en: And Judah acknowledged them, and said: 'She is more righteous than I; forasmuch as I gave her not to Shelah my son.' And he knew her again no more.

tanach-bereishit|38:27.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

tanach-bereishit|38:28.en: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that one put out a hand; and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying: 'This came out first.'

tanach-bereishit|38:29.en: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold his brother came out; and she said: 'Wherefore hast thou made a breach for thyself?' Therefore his name was called Perez.

tanach-bereishit|38:30.en: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand; and his name was called Zerah.

tanach-bereishit|39:1.en: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmaelites, that had brought him down thither.

tanach-bereishit|39:2.en: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

tanach-bereishit|39:3.en: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

tanach-bereishit|39:4.en: And Joseph found favour in his sight, and he ministered unto him. And he appointed him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

tanach-bereishit|39:5.en: And it came to pass from the time that he appointed him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the Lord was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.

tanach-bereishit|39:6.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and, having him, he knew not aught save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was of beautiful form, and fair to look upon.

tanach-bereishit|39:7.en: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said: 'Lie with me.'

tanach-bereishit|39:8.en: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife: 'Behold, my master, having me, knoweth not what is in the house, and he hath put all that he hath into my hand;

tanach-bereishit|39:9.en: he is not greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?'

tanach-bereishit|39:10.en: And it came to pass, as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

tanach-bereishit|39:11.en: And it came to pass on a certain day, when he went into the house to do his work, and there was none of the men of the house there within,

tanach-bereishit|39:12.en: that she caught him by his garment, saying: 'Lie with me.' And he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

tanach-bereishit|39:13.en: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

tanach-bereishit|39:14.en: that she called unto the men of her house, and spoke unto them, saying: 'See, he hath brought in a Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

tanach-bereishit|39:15.en: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.'

tanach-bereishit|39:16.en: And she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

tanach-bereishit|39:17.en: And she spoke unto him according to these words, saying: 'The Hebrew servant, whom thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me.

tanach-bereishit|39:18.en: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled out.'

tanach-bereishit|39:19.en: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke unto him, saying: 'After this manner did thy servant to me'; that his wrath was kindled.

tanach-bereishit|39:20.en: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were bound; and he was there in the prison.

tanach-bereishit|39:21.en: But the Lord was with Joseph, and showed kindness unto him, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

tanach-bereishit|39:22.en: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

tanach-bereishit|39:23.en: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand, because the Lord was with him; and that which he did, the Lord made it to prosper.

tanach-bereishit|40:1.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|40:2.en: And Pharaoh was wroth against his two officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

tanach-bereishit|40:3.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

tanach-bereishit|40:4.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph to be with them, and he ministered unto them; and they continued a season in ward.

tanach-bereishit|40:5.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

tanach-bereishit|40:6.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and saw them, and, behold, they were sad.

tanach-bereishit|40:7.en: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his master's house, saying: 'Wherefore look ye so sad to-day?'

tanach-bereishit|40:8.en: And they said unto him: 'We have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it.' And Joseph said unto them: 'Do not interpretations belong to God? tell it me, I pray you.'

tanach-bereishit|40:9.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him: 'In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

tanach-bereishit|40:10.en: and in the vine were three branches; and as it was budding, its blossoms shot forth, and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes,

tanach-bereishit|40:11.en: and Pharaoh's cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.'

tanach-bereishit|40:12.en: And Joseph said unto him: 'This is the interpretation of it: the three branches are three days;

tanach-bereishit|40:13.en: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head, and restore thee unto thine office; and thou shalt give Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

tanach-bereishit|40:14.en: But have me in thy remembrance when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

tanach-bereishit|40:15.en: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews; and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.'

tanach-bereishit|40:16.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph: 'I also saw in my dream, and, behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head;

tanach-bereishit|40:17.en: and in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of baked food for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.'

tanach-bereishit|40:18.en: And Joseph answered and said: 'This is the interpretation thereof: the three baskets are three days;

tanach-bereishit|40:19.en: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.'

tanach-bereishit|40:20.en: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants; and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

tanach-bereishit|40:21.en: And he restored the chief butler back unto his butlership; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

tanach-bereishit|40:22.en: But he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

tanach-bereishit|40:23.en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgot him.

tanach-bereishit|41:1.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

tanach-bereishit|41:2.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, well-favoured and fat-fleshed; and they fed in the reed-grass.

tanach-bereishit|41:3.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill-favoured and lean-fleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

tanach-bereishit|41:4.en: And the ill-favoured and lean-fleshed kine did eat up the seven well-favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

tanach-bereishit|41:5.en: And he slept and dreamed a second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

tanach-bereishit|41:6.en: And, behold, seven ears, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

tanach-melachim-a|3:15.en: And Solomon awoke, and, behold, it was a dream; and he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up burnt-offerings, and offered peace-offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

tanach-melachim-a|3:16.en: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

tanach-melachim-a|3:17.en: And the one woman said: 'Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

tanach-melachim-a|3:18.en: And it came to pass the third day after I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also; and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

tanach-melachim-a|3:19.en: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlay it.

tanach-melachim-a|3:20.en: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thy handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

tanach-mishlei|8:33.en: Hear instruction, and be wise, And refuse it not.

tanach-mishlei|8:34.en: Happy is the man that hearkeneth to me, Watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

tanach-mishlei|8:35.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life, And obtaineth favour of the Lord.

tanach-mishlei|8:36.en: But he that misseth me wrongeth his own soul; All they that hate me love death.'

tanach-mishlei|9:1.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, She hath hewn out her seven pillars;

tanach-mishlei|9:2.en: She hath prepared her meat, she hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table.

tanach-bereishit|41:7.en: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

tanach-bereishit|41:8.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof; and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|41:9.en: Then spoke the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying: 'I make mention of my faults this day:

tanach-bereishit|41:10.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in the ward of the house of the captain of the guard, me and the chief baker.

tanach-melachim-a|3:21.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead; but when I had looked well at it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, whom I did bear.'

tanach-melachim-a|3:22.en: And the other woman said: 'Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son.' And this said: 'No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son.' Thus they spoke before the king.

tanach-melachim-a|3:23.en: Then said the king: 'The one saith: This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead; and the other saith: Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.'

tanach-melachim-a|3:24.en: And the king said: 'Fetch me a sword.' And they brought a sword before the king.

tanach-mishlei|9:3.en: She hath sent forth her maidens, she calleth, Upon the highest places of the city:

tanach-mishlei|9:4.en: 'Whoso is thoughtless, let him turn in hither'; As for him that lacketh understanding, she saith to him:

tanach-mishlei|9:5.en: 'Come, eat of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.

tanach-mishlei|9:6.en: Forsake all thoughtlessness, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.

tanach-bereishit|41:11.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

tanach-bereishit|41:12.en: And there was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

tanach-bereishit|41:13.en: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was: I was restored unto mine office, and he was hanged.'

tanach-bereishit|41:14.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. And he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|41:15.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: 'I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it; and I have heard say of thee, that when thou hearest a dream thou canst interpret it.'

tanach-melachim-a|3:25.en: And the king said: 'Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.'

tanach-melachim-a|3:26.en: Then spoke the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her heart yearned upon her son, and she said: 'Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it.' But the other said: 'It shall be neither mine nor thine; divide it.'

tanach-melachim-a|3:27.en: Then the king answered and said: 'Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.'

tanach-melachim-a|3:28.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.

tanach-melachim-a|4:1.en: And king Solomon was king over all Israel.

tanach-mishlei|9:7.en: He that correcteth a scorner getteth to himself shame, And he that reproveth a wicked man, it becometh unto him a blot.

tanach-mishlei|9:8.en: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee; Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.

tanach-mishlei|9:9.en: Give to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser; Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.

tanach-mishlei|9:10.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the All-holy is understanding.

tanach-mishlei|9:11.en: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.

tanach-bereishit|41:16.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying: 'It is not in me; God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.'

tanach-bereishit|41:17.en: And Pharaoh spoke unto Joseph: 'In my dream, behold, I stood upon the brink of the river.

tanach-bereishit|41:18.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fat-fleshed and well-favoured; and they fed in the reed-grass.

tanach-bereishit|41:19.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill-favoured and lean-fleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness.

tanach-bereishit|41:20.en: And the lean and ill-favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine.

tanach-bereishit|41:21.en: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill-favoured as at the beginning. So I awoke.

tanach-melachim-a|4:2.en: And these were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

tanach-melachim-a|4:3.en: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

tanach-melachim-a|4:4.en: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

tanach-melachim-a|4:5.en: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister and the king's friend;

tanach-melachim-a|4:6.en: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the levy.

tanach-melachim-a|4:7.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided victuals for the king and his household: each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

tanach-mishlei|9:12.en: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.'

tanach-mishlei|9:13.en: The woman Folly is riotous; She is thoughtless, and knoweth nothing.

tanach-mishlei|9:14.en: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,

tanach-mishlei|9:15.en: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:

tanach-mishlei|9:16.en: 'Whoso is thoughtless, let him turn in hither'; And as for him that lacketh understanding, she saith to him:

tanach-mishlei|9:17.en: 'Stolen waters are sweet, And bread eaten in secret is pleasant.'

tanach-bereishit|41:22.en: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up upon one stalk, full and good.

tanach-bereishit|41:23.en: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

tanach-bereishit|41:24.en: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears. And I told it unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.'

tanach-bereishit|41:25.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh: 'The dream of Pharaoh is one; what God is about to do He hath declared unto Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|41:26.en: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

tanach-melachim-a|4:8.en: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in the hill-country of Ephraim;

tanach-melachim-a|4:9.en: the son of Deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;

tanach-melachim-a|4:10.en: the son of Hesed, in Arubboth; to him pertained Socoh, and all the land of Hepher;

tanach-melachim-a|4:11.en: the son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife;

tanach-melachim-a|4:12.en: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

tanach-mishlei|9:18.en: But he knoweth not that the shades are there; That her guests are in the depths of the nether-world.

tanach-mishlei|10:1.en: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the grief of his mother.

tanach-mishlei|10:2.en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; But righteousness delivereth from death.

tanach-mishlei|10:3.en: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But He thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.

tanach-mishlei|10:4.en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand; But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

tanach-bereishit|41:27.en: And the seven lean and ill-favoured kine that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind; they shall be seven years of famine.

tanach-bereishit|41:28.en: That is the thing which I spoke unto Pharaoh: what God is about to do He hath shown unto Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|41:29.en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|41:30.en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

tanach-bereishit|41:31.en: and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine which followeth; for it shall be very grievous.

tanach-bereishit|41:32.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice, it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

tanach-bereishit|41:33.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|41:34.en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven years of plenty.

tanach-bereishit|41:35.en: And let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

tanach-bereishit|41:36.en: And the food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.'

tanach-bereishit|41:37.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

tanach-bereishit|41:38.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants: 'Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom the spirit of God is?'

tanach-bereishit|41:39.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: 'Forasmuch as God hath shown thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou.

tanach-bereishit|41:40.en: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled; only in the throne will I be greater than thou.'

tanach-bereishit|41:41.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: 'See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.'

tanach-bereishit|41:42.en: And Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

tanach-bereishit|41:43.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him: 'Abrech'; and he set him over all the land of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|41:44.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: 'I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.'

tanach-bereishit|41:45.en: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.—

tanach-bereishit|41:46.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt.—And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|41:47.en: And in the seven years of plenty the earth brought forth in heaps.

tanach-bereishit|41:48.en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities; the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

tanach-bereishit|41:49.en: And Joseph laid up corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until they left off numbering; for it was without number.

tanach-bereishit|41:50.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On bore unto him.

tanach-bereishit|41:51.en: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh: 'for God hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.'

tanach-bereishit|41:52.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: 'for God hath made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.'

apparatus.text: From a Hebrew word signifying to be fruitful.

tanach-bereishit|41:53.en: And the seven years of plenty, that was in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

tanach-bereishit|41:54.en: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said; and there was famine in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

tanach-bereishit|41:55.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread; and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians: 'Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.'

tanach-bereishit|41:56.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth; and Joseph opened all the store-houses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine was sore in the land of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|41:57.en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph to buy corn; because the famine was sore in all the earth.

tanach-bereishit|42:1.en: Now Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, and Jacob said unto his sons: 'Why do ye look one upon another?'

tanach-bereishit|42:2.en: And he said: 'Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt. Get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.'

tanach-bereishit|42:3.en: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn from Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|42:4.en: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said: 'Lest peradventure harm befall him.'

tanach-bereishit|42:5.en: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those that came; for the famine was in the land of Caanan.

tanach-bereishit|42:6.en: And Joseph was the governor over the land; he it was that sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down to him with their faces to the earth.

tanach-bereishit|42:7.en: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spoke roughly with them; and he said unto them: 'Whence come ye?' And they said: 'From the land of Canaan to buy food.'

tanach-bereishit|42:8.en: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew him not.

tanach-bereishit|42:9.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them: 'Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.'

tanach-bereishit|42:10.en: And they said unto him: 'Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

tanach-bereishit|42:11.en: We are all one man's sons; we are upright men, thy servants are no spies.'

tanach-bereishit|42:12.en: And he said unto them: 'Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.'

tanach-bereishit|42:13.en: And they said: 'We thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.'

tanach-bereishit|42:14.en: And Joseph said unto them: 'That is it that I spoke unto you, saying: Ye are spies.

tanach-bereishit|42:15.en: Hereby ye shall be proved, as Pharaoh liveth, ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

tanach-bereishit|42:16.en: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be bound, that your words may be proved, whether there be truth in you; or else, as Pharaoh liveth, surely ye are spies.'

tanach-bereishit|42:17.en: And he put them all together into ward three days.

tanach-bereishit|42:18.en: And Joseph said unto them the third day.' This do, and live; for I fear God:

tanach-bereishit|42:19.en: if ye be upright men, let one of your brethren be bound in your prison-house; but go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses;

tanach-bereishit|42:20.en: and bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die.' And they did so.

tanach-bereishit|42:21.en: And they said one to another: 'We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.'

tanach-bereishit|42:22.en: And Reuben answered them, saying: 'Spoke I not unto you, saying: Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore also, behold, his blood is required.'

tanach-bereishit|42:23.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for the interpreter was between them.

tanach-bereishit|42:24.en: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

tanach-bereishit|42:25.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their vessels with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way; and thus was it done unto them.

tanach-bereishit|42:26.en: And they laded their asses with their corn, and departed thence.

tanach-bereishit|42:27.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the lodging-place, he espied his money; and, behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

tanach-bereishit|42:28.en: And he said unto his brethren: 'My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack.' And their heart failed them, and they turned trembling one to another, saying: 'What is this that God hath done unto us?'

tanach-bereishit|42:29.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that had befallen them, saying:

tanach-bereishit|42:30.en: 'The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

tanach-bereishit|42:31.en: And we said unto him: We are upright men; we are no spies.

tanach-bereishit|42:32.en: We are twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

tanach-bereishit|42:33.en: And the man, the lord of the land, said unto us: Hereby shall I know that ye are upright men: leave one of your brethren with me, and take corn for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

tanach-bereishit|42:34.en: And bring your youngest brother unto me; then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are upright men; so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffic in the land.'

tanach-bereishit|42:35.en: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack; and when they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

tanach-bereishit|42:36.en: And Jacob their father said unto them: 'Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away; upon me are all these things come.'

tanach-bereishit|42:37.en: And Reuben spoke unto his father, saying: 'Thou shalt slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee; deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him back to thee.'

tanach-bereishit|42:38.en: And he said: 'My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left; if harm befall him by the way in which ye go, then will ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

tanach-bereishit|43:1.en: And the famine was sore in the land.

tanach-bereishit|43:2.en: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, that their father said unto them: 'Go again, buy us a little food.'

tanach-bereishit|43:3.en: And Judah spoke unto him, saying: 'The man did earnestly forewarn us, saying: Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

tanach-bereishit|43:4.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food;

tanach-bereishit|43:5.en: but if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down, for the man said unto us: Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.'

tanach-bereishit|43:6.en: And Israel said: 'Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?'

tanach-bereishit|43:7.en: And they said: 'The man asked straitly concerning ourselves, and concerning our kindred, saying: Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words; could we in any wise know that he would say: Bring your brother down?'

tanach-bereishit|43:8.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father: 'Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go, that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

tanach-bereishit|43:9.en: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him; if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever.

tanach-bereishit|43:10.en: For except we had lingered, surely we had now returned a second time.'

tanach-bereishit|43:11.en: And their father Israel said unto them: 'If it be so now, do this: take of the choice fruits of the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spicery and ladanum, nuts, and almonds;

tanach-bereishit|43:12.en: and take double money in your hand; and the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks carry back in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight;

tanach-bereishit|43:13.en: take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man;

tanach-bereishit|43:14.en: and God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release unto you your other brother and Benjamin. And as for me, if I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.'

tanach-bereishit|43:15.en: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

tanach-bereishit|43:16.en: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house: 'Bring the men into the house, and kill the beasts, and prepare the meat; for the men shall dine with me at noon.'

tanach-bereishit|43:17.en: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

tanach-bereishit|43:18.en: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said: 'Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.'

tanach-bereishit|43:19.en: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they spoke unto him at the door of the house,

tanach-bereishit|43:20.en: and said: 'Oh my lord, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food.

tanach-bereishit|43:21.en: And it came to pass, when we came to the lodging-place, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight; and we have brought it back in our hand.

tanach-bereishit|43:22.en: And other money have we brought down in our hand to buy food. We know not who put our money in our sacks.'

tanach-bereishit|43:23.en: And he said: 'Peace be to you, fear not; your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks; I had your money.' And he brought Simeon out unto them.

tanach-bereishit|43:24.en: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

tanach-bereishit|43:25.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph's coming at noon; for they heard that they should eat bread there.

tanach-bereishit|43:26.en: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed down to him to the earth.

tanach-bereishit|43:27.en: And he asked them of their welfare, and said: 'Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spoke? Is he yet alive?'

tanach-bereishit|43:28.en: And they said: 'Thy servant our father is well, he is yet alive.' And they bowed the head, and made obeisance.

tanach-bereishit|43:29.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin his brother, his mother's son, and said: 'Is this your youngest brother of whom ye spoke unto me?' And he said: 'God be gracious unto thee, my son.'

tanach-bereishit|43:30.en: And Joseph made haste; for his heart yearned toward his brother; and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

tanach-bereishit|43:31.en: And he washed his face, and came out; and he refrained himself, and said: 'Set on bread.'

tanach-bereishit|43:32.en: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, that did eat with him, by themselves; because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

tanach-bereishit|43:33.en: And they sat before him, the first-born according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth; and the men marvelled one with another.

tanach-bereishit|43:34.en: And portions were taken unto them from before him; but Benjamin's portion was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

tanach-bereishit|44:1.en: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying: 'Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

tanach-bereishit|44:2.en: And put my goblet, the silver goblet, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money.' And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

tanach-bereishit|44:3.en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

tanach-bereishit|44:4.en: And when they were gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward: 'Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them: Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

tanach-bereishit|44:5.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby he indeed divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.'

tanach-bereishit|44:6.en: And he overtook them, and he spoke unto them these words.

tanach-bereishit|44:7.en: And they said unto him: 'Wherefore speaketh my lord such words as these? Far be it from thy servants that they should do such a thing.

tanach-bereishit|44:8.en: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought back unto thee out of the land of Canaan; how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?

tanach-bereishit|44:9.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.'

tanach-bereishit|44:10.en: And he said: 'Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my bondman; and ye shall be blameless.'

tanach-bereishit|44:11.en: Then they hastened, and took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

tanach-bereishit|44:12.en: And he searched, beginning at the eldest, and leaving off at the youngest; and the goblet was found in Benjamin's sack.

tanach-bereishit|44:13.en: And they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

tanach-bereishit|44:14.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house, and he was yet there; and they fell before him on the ground.

tanach-bereishit|44:15.en: And Joseph said unto them: 'What deed is this that ye have done? know ye not that such a man as I will indeed divine?'

tanach-bereishit|44:16.en: And Judah said: 'What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants; behold, we are my lord's bondmen, both we, and he also in whose hand the cup is found.'

tanach-bereishit|44:17.en: And he said: 'Far be it from me that I should do so; the man in whose hand the goblet is found, he shall be my bondman; but as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.'

tanach-bereishit|44:18.en: Then Judah came near unto him, and said: 'Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant; for thou art even as Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|44:19.en: My lord asked his servants, saying: Have ye a father, or a brother?

tanach-bereishit|44:20.en: And we said unto my lord: We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

tanach-bereishit|44:21.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants: Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

tanach-bereishit|44:22.en: And we said unto my lord: The lad cannot leave his father; for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

tanach-bereishit|44:23.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants: Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

tanach-yechezkel|37:15.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:

tanach-yechezkel|37:16.en: 'And thou, son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it: For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions; then take another stick, and write upon it: For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and of all the house of Israel his companions;

tanach-yechezkel|37:17.en: and join them for thee one to another into one stick, that they may become one in thy hand.

tanach-yechezkel|37:18.en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying: Wilt thou not tell us what thou meanest by these?

tanach-yechezkel|37:19.en: say unto them: Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them unto him together with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in My hand.

tanach-yechezkel|37:20.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thy hand before their eyes.

tanach-mishlei|10:5.en: A wise son gathereth in summer; But a son that doeth shamefully sleepeth in harvest.

tanach-mishlei|10:6.en: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; But the mouth of the wicked concealeth violence.

tanach-mishlei|10:7.en: The memory of the righteous shall be for a blessing; But the name of the wicked shall rot.

tanach-mishlei|10:8.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments; But a prating fool shall fall.

tanach-mishlei|10:9.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh securely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be found out.

tanach-mishlei|10:10.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; And a prating fool shall fall.

tanach-bereishit|44:24.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

tanach-bereishit|44:25.en: And our father said: Go again, buy us a little food.

tanach-bereishit|44:26.en: And we said: We cannot go down; if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down; for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.

tanach-bereishit|44:27.en: And thy servant my father said unto us: Ye know that my wife bore me two sons;

tanach-yechezkel|37:21.en: And say unto them: Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, whither they are gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land;

tanach-yechezkel|37:22.en: and I will make them one nation in the land, upon the mountains of Israel, and one king shall be king to them all; and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all;

tanach-yechezkel|37:23.en: neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling-places, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them; so shall they be My people, and I will be their God.

tanach-yechezkel|37:24.en: And My servant David shall be king over them, and they all shall have one shepherd; they shall also walk in Mine ordinances, and observe My statutes, and do them.

tanach-mishlei|10:11.en: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But the mouth of the wicked concealeth violence.

tanach-mishlei|10:12.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.

tanach-mishlei|10:13.en: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

tanach-mishlei|10:14.en: Wise men lay up knowledge; But the mouth of the foolish is an imminent ruin.

tanach-bereishit|44:28.en: and the one went out from me, and I said: Surely he is torn in pieces; and I have not seen him since;

tanach-bereishit|44:29.en: and if ye take this one also from me, and harm befall him, ye will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

tanach-bereishit|44:30.en: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad is not with us; seeing that his soul is bound up with the lad's soul;

tanach-bereishit|44:31.en: it will come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die; and thy servants will bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

tanach-bereishit|44:32.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying: If I bring him not unto thee, then shall I bear the blame to my father for ever.

tanach-yechezkel|37:25.en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob My servant, wherein your fathers dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children's children, for ever; and David My servant shall be their prince for ever.

tanach-yechezkel|37:26.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them—it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will establish them, and multiply them, and will set My sanctuary in the midst of them for ever.

tanach-yechezkel|37:27.en: My dwelling-place also shall be over them; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

tanach-yechezkel|37:28.en: And the nations shall know that I am the Lord that sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for ever.'

tanach-yechezkel|38:1.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying:

tanach-mishlei|10:15.en: The rich man's wealth is his strong city; The ruin of the poor is their poverty.

tanach-mishlei|10:16.en: The wages of the righteous is life; The increase of the wicked is sin.

tanach-mishlei|10:17.en: He is in the way of life that heedeth instruction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.

tanach-mishlei|10:18.en: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.

tanach-mishlei|10:19.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips is wise.

tanach-bereishit|44:33.en: Now therefore, let thy servant, I pray thee, abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

tanach-bereishit|44:34.en: For how shall I go up to my father, if the lad be not with me? lest I look upon the evil that shall come on my father.'

tanach-bereishit|45:1.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried: 'Cause every man to go out from me.' And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

tanach-bereishit|45:2.en: And he wept aloud; and the Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

tanach-bereishit|45:3.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren: 'I am Joseph; doth my father yet live?' And his brethren could not answer him; for they were affrighted at his presence.

tanach-bereishit|45:4.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren: 'Come near to me, I pray you.' And they came near. And he said: 'I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

tanach-yechezkel|38:2.en: 'Son of man, set thy face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

tanach-yechezkel|38:3.en: and say: Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal;

tanach-yechezkel|38:4.en: and I will turn thee about, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed most gorgeously, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords:

tanach-yechezkel|38:5.en: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

tanach-yechezkel|38:6.en: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his bands; even many peoples with thee.

tanach-yechezkel|38:7.en: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

notes.he: לפי ״והיית להם למשמר״ אפשר להבין שגוג יהיה שומר לאנשיו. בתרגום האנגלי ההיסטורי גוג הוא הנשמר.
notes.en: “Be thou a guard unto them” takes Gog as their guardian. The historical English instead reads “be thou guarded of them,” with Gog as the one guarded.

tanach-mishlei|10:20.en: The tongue of the righteous is as choice silver; The heart of the wicked is little worth.

tanach-mishlei|10:21.en: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for want of understanding.

tanach-mishlei|10:22.en: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, And toil addeth nothing thereto.

tanach-mishlei|10:23.en: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness, And so is wisdom to a man of discernment.

tanach-mishlei|10:24.en: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

tanach-mishlei|10:25.en: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

tanach-bereishit|45:5.en: And now be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither; for God did send me before you to preserve life.

tanach-bereishit|45:6.en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land; and there are yet five years, in which there shall be neither plowing nor harvest.

tanach-bereishit|45:7.en: And God sent me before you to give you a remnant on the earth, and to save you alive for a great deliverance.

tanach-bereishit|45:8.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God; and He hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|45:9.en: Hasten ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him: Thus saith thy son Joseph: God hath made me lord of all Egypt; come down unto me, tarry not.

tanach-yechezkel|38:8.en: After many days thou shalt be mustered for service, in the latter years thou shalt come against the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, against the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought forth out of the peoples, and they dwell safely all of them.

tanach-yechezkel|38:9.en: And thou shalt ascend, thou shalt come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many peoples with thee.

tanach-yechezkel|38:10.en: Thus saith the Lord God: It shall come to pass in that day, that things shall come into thy mind, and thou shalt devise an evil device;

tanach-yechezkel|38:11.en: and thou shalt say: I will go up against the land of unwalled villages; I will come upon them that are at quiet, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates;

tanach-yechezkel|38:12.en: to take the spoil and to take the prey; to turn thy hand against the waste places that are now inhabited, and against the people that are gathered out of the nations, that have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the middle of the earth.

tanach-mishlei|10:26.en: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.

tanach-mishlei|10:27.en: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

tanach-mishlei|10:28.en: The hope of the righteous is gladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

tanach-mishlei|10:29.en: The way of the Lord is a stronghold to the upright, But ruin to the workers of iniquity.

tanach-mishlei|10:30.en: The righteous shall never be moved; But the wicked shall not inhabit the land.

tanach-bereishit|45:10.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast;

tanach-bereishit|45:11.en: and there will I sustain thee; for there are yet five years of famine; lest thou come to poverty, thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast.

tanach-bereishit|45:12.en: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
