tanach-bereishit|45:13.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall hasten and bring down my father hither.'

tanach-bereishit|45:14.en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

tanach-bereishit|45:15.en: And he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them; and after that his brethren talked with him.

tanach-bereishit|45:16.en: And the report thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying: 'Joseph's brethren are come'; and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

tanach-bereishit|45:17.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: 'Say unto thy brethren: This do ye: lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

tanach-bereishit|45:18.en: and take your father and your households, and come unto me; and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

tanach-bereishit|45:19.en: Now thou art commanded, this do ye: take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

tanach-bereishit|45:20.en: Also regard not your stuff; for the good things of all the land of Egypt are yours.'

tanach-bereishit|45:21.en: And the sons of Israel did so; and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

tanach-bereishit|45:22.en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver, and five changes of raiment.

tanach-bereishit|45:23.en: And to his father he sent in like manner ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she-asses laden with corn and bread and victual for his father by the way.

tanach-bereishit|45:24.en: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed; and he said unto them: 'See that ye fall not out by the way.'

tanach-bereishit|45:25.en: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father.

tanach-bereishit|45:26.en: And they told him, saying: 'Joseph is yet alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.' And his heart fainted, for he believed them not.

tanach-bereishit|45:27.en: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them; and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.

tanach-bereishit|45:28.en: And Israel said: 'It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive; I will go and see him before I die.'

tanach-bereishit|46:1.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

tanach-bereishit|46:2.en: And God spoke unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said: 'Jacob, Jacob.' And he said: 'Here am I.'

tanach-bereishit|46:3.en: And He said: 'I am God, the God of thy father; fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation.

tanach-bereishit|46:4.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again; and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.'

tanach-bereishit|46:5.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba; and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

tanach-bereishit|46:6.en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him;

tanach-bereishit|46:7.en: his sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|46:8.en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's first-born.

tanach-bereishit|46:9.en: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Pallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

tanach-bereishit|46:10.en: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

tanach-bereishit|46:11.en: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

tanach-bereishit|46:12.en: And the sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

tanach-bereishit|46:13.en: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puvah, and Iob, and Shimron.

tanach-bereishit|46:14.en: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

tanach-bereishit|46:15.en: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore unto Jacob in Paddan-aram, with his daughter Dinah; all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

tanach-bereishit|46:16.en: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

tanach-bereishit|46:17.en: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel.

tanach-bereishit|46:18.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bore unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

tanach-bereishit|46:19.en: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

tanach-bereishit|46:20.en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On bore unto him.

tanach-bereishit|46:21.en: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

tanach-bereishit|46:22.en: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob; all the souls were fourteen.

tanach-bereishit|46:23.en: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.

tanach-bereishit|46:24.en: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

tanach-bereishit|46:25.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and these she bore unto Jacob; all the souls were seven.

tanach-bereishit|46:26.en: All the souls belonging to Jacob that came into Egypt, that came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six.

tanach-bereishit|46:27.en: And the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls; all the souls of the house of Jacob, that came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

tanach-bereishit|46:28.en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to show the way before him unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

tanach-bereishit|46:29.en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen; and he presented himself unto him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

tanach-bereishit|46:30.en: And Israel said unto Joseph: 'Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, that thou art yet alive.'

tanach-bereishit|46:31.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house: 'I will go up, and tell Pharaoh, and will say unto him: My brethren, and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

tanach-bereishit|46:32.en: and the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

tanach-bereishit|46:33.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say: What is your occupation?

tanach-bereishit|46:34.en: that ye shall say: Thy servants have been keepers of cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers; that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.'

tanach-bereishit|47:1.en: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said: 'My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.'

tanach-bereishit|47:2.en: And from among his brethren he took five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|47:3.en: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren: 'What is your occupation?' And they said unto Pharaoh: 'Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.'

tanach-bereishit|47:4.en: And they said unto Pharaoh: 'To sojourn in the land are we come; for there is no pasture for thy servants' flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.'

tanach-bereishit|47:5.en: And Pharaoh spoke unto Joseph, saying: 'Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee;

tanach-bereishit|47:6.en: the land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and thy brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell. And if thou knowest any able men among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.'

tanach-bereishit|47:7.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|47:8.en: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob: 'How many are the days of the years of thy life?'

tanach-bereishit|47:9.en: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh: 'The days of the years of my sojournings are a hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their sojournings.'

tanach-bereishit|47:10.en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

tanach-bereishit|47:11.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

tanach-bereishit|47:12.en: And Joseph sustained his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to the want of their little ones.

tanach-bereishit|47:13.en: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished by reason of the famine.

tanach-bereishit|47:14.en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought; and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

tanach-bereishit|47:15.en: And when the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said: 'Give us bread; for why should we die in thy presence? for our money faileth.'

tanach-bereishit|47:16.en: And Joseph said: 'Give your cattle, and I will give you [bread] for your cattle, if money fail.'

tanach-bereishit|47:17.en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph. And Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the asses; and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their cattle for that year.

tanach-bereishit|47:18.en: And when that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him: 'We will not hide from my lord, how that our money is all spent; and the herds of cattle are my lord's; there is nought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.

tanach-bereishit|47:19.en: Wherefore should we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be bondmen unto Pharaoh; and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land be not desolate.'

tanach-bereishit|47:20.en: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine was sore upon them; and the land became Pharaoh's.

tanach-bereishit|47:21.en: And as for the people, he removed them city by city, from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

tanach-bereishit|47:22.en: Only the land of the priests bought he not, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them; wherefore they sold not their land.

tanach-bereishit|47:23.en: Then Joseph said unto the people: 'Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh. Lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

tanach-bereishit|47:24.en: And it shall come to pass at the ingatherings, that ye shall give a fifth unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.'

tanach-bereishit|47:25.en: And they said: 'Thou hast saved our lives. Let us find favour in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's bondmen.'

tanach-bereishit|47:26.en: And Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth; only the land of the priests alone became not Pharaoh's.

tanach-bereishit|47:27.en: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got them possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

tanach-bereishit|47:28.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years; so the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were a hundred forty and seven years.

tanach-bereishit|47:29.en: And the time drew near that Israel must die; and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him: 'If now I have found favour in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt.

tanach-bereishit|47:30.en: But when I sleep with my fathers, thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying-place.' And he said: 'I will do as thou hast said.'

tanach-bereishit|47:31.en: And he said: 'Swear unto me.' And he swore unto him. And Israel bowed down upon the bed's head.

tanach-bereishit|48:1.en: And it came to pass after these things, that one said to Joseph: 'Behold, thy father is sick.' And he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

tanach-bereishit|48:2.en: And one told Jacob, and said: 'Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee.' And Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

tanach-melachim-a|2:1.en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying:

tanach-melachim-a|2:2.en: 'I go the way of all the earth; be thou strong therefore, and show thyself a man;

tanach-melachim-a|2:3.en: and keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in His ways, to keep His statutes, and His commandments, and His ordinances, and His testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself;

tanach-melachim-a|2:4.en: that the Lord may establish His word which He spoke concerning me, saying: If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before Me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee, said He, a man on the throne of Israel.

tanach-melachim-a|2:5.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did unto me, even what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

tanach-melachim-a|2:6.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

tanach-mishlei|10:31.en: The mouth of the righteous buddeth with wisdom; But the froward tongue shall be cut off.

tanach-mishlei|10:32.en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wicked is all frowardness.

tanach-mishlei|11:1.en: A false balance is an abomination to the Lord, But a perfect weight is His delight.

tanach-mishlei|11:2.en: When pride cometh, then cometh shame; But with the lowly is wisdom.

tanach-mishlei|11:3.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; But the perverseness of the faithless shall destroy them.

tanach-mishlei|11:4.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath; But righteousness delivereth from death.

tanach-bereishit|48:3.en: And Jacob said unto Joseph: 'God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

tanach-bereishit|48:4.en: and said unto me: Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a company of peoples; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

tanach-bereishit|48:5.en: And now thy two sons, who were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, shall be mine.

tanach-bereishit|48:6.en: And thy issue, that thou begettest after them, shall be thine; they shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

tanach-melachim-a|2:7.en: But show kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table; for so they drew nigh unto me when I fled from Absalom thy brother.

tanach-melachim-a|2:8.en: And, behold, there is with thee Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying: I will not put thee to death with the sword.

tanach-melachim-a|2:9.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless, for thou art a wise man; and thou wilt know what thou oughtest to do unto him, and thou shalt bring his hoar head down to the grave with blood.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:10.en: And David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

tanach-mishlei|11:5.en: The righteousness of the sincere shall make straight his way; But the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

tanach-mishlei|11:6.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them; But the faithless shall be trapped in their own crafty device.

tanach-mishlei|11:7.en: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish, And the hope of strength perisheth.

tanach-mishlei|11:8.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, And the wicked cometh in his stead.

tanach-bereishit|48:7.en: And as for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died unto me in the land of Canaan in the way, when there was still some way to come unto Ephrath; and I buried her there in the way to Ephrath—the same is Beth-lehem.'

tanach-bereishit|48:8.en: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said: 'Who are these?'

tanach-bereishit|48:9.en: And Joseph said unto his father: 'They are my sons, whom God hath given me here.' And he said: 'Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.'

tanach-bereishit|48:10.en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

tanach-bereishit|48:11.en: And Israel said unto Joseph: 'I had not thought to see thy face; and, lo, God hath let me see thy seed also.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:11.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

tanach-melachim-a|2:12.en: And Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established firmly.

tanach-melachim-a|2:13.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said: 'Comest thou peaceably?' And he said: 'Peaceably.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:14.en: He said moreover: 'I have somewhat to say unto thee.' And she said: 'Say on.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:15.en: And he said: 'Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign; howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's; for it was his from the Lord.

tanach-mishlei|11:9.en: With his mouth the impious man destroyeth his neighbour; But through knowledge shall the righteous be delivered.

tanach-mishlei|11:10.en: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is joy.

tanach-mishlei|11:11.en: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted; But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

tanach-mishlei|11:12.en: He that despiseth his neighbour lacketh understanding; But a man of discernment holdeth his peace.

tanach-mishlei|11:13.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets; But he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth a matter.

tanach-bereishit|48:12.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees; and he fell down on his face to the earth.

tanach-bereishit|48:13.en: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.

tanach-bereishit|48:14.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the first-born.

tanach-bereishit|48:15.en: And he blessed Joseph, and said: 'The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God who hath been my shepherd all my life long unto this day,

tanach-bereishit|48:16.en: the angel who hath redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named in them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.'

tanach-bereishit|48:17.en: And when Joseph saw that his father was laying his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him, and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.

tanach-melachim-a|2:16.en: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not.' And she said unto him: 'Say on.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:17.en: And he said: 'Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king—for he will not say thee nay—that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:18.en: And Bath-sheba said: 'Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:19.en: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed down unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

tanach-melachim-a|2:20.en: Then she said: 'I ask one small petition of thee; deny me not.' And the king said unto her: 'Ask on, my mother; for I will not deny thee.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:21.en: And she said: 'Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.'

tanach-mishlei|11:14.en: Where no wise direction is, a people falleth; But in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

tanach-mishlei|11:15.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it; But he that hateth them that strike hands is secure.

tanach-mishlei|11:16.en: A gracious woman obtaineth honour; And strong men obtain riches.

tanach-mishlei|11:17.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

tanach-mishlei|11:18.en: The wicked earneth deceitful wages; But he that soweth righteousness hath a sure reward.

tanach-mishlei|11:19.en: Stedfast righteousness tendeth to life; But he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

tanach-bereishit|48:18.en: And Joseph said unto his father: 'Not so, my father, for this is the first-born; put thy right hand upon his head.'

tanach-bereishit|48:19.en: And his father refused, and said: 'I know it, my son, I know it; he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great; howbeit his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.'

tanach-bereishit|48:20.en: And he blessed them that day, saying: 'By thee shall Israel bless, saying: God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh.' And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

tanach-bereishit|48:21.en: And Israel said unto Joseph: 'Behold, I die; but God will be with you, and bring you back unto the land of your fathers.

tanach-bereishit|48:22.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:22.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother: 'And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:23.en: Then king Solomon swore by the Lord, saying: 'God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

tanach-melachim-a|2:24.en: Now therefore as the Lord liveth, who hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me a house, as He promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death this day.'

tanach-melachim-a|2:25.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him, so that he died.

tanach-melachim-a|2:26.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king: 'Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art deserving of death; but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou didst bear the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and because thou wast afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.'

tanach-mishlei|11:20.en: They that are perverse in heart are an abomination to the Lord; But such as are upright in their way are His delight.

tanach-mishlei|11:21.en: My hand upon it! the evil man shall not be unpunished; But the seed of the righteous shall escape.

tanach-mishlei|11:22.en: As a ring of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman that turneth aside from discretion.

tanach-mishlei|11:23.en: The desire of the righteous is only good; But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

tanach-mishlei|11:24.en: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth only to want.

tanach-bereishit|49:1.en: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said: 'Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the end of days.

tanach-bereishit|49:2.en: Assemble yourselves, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; And hearken unto Israel your father.

tanach-bereishit|49:3.en: Reuben, thou art my first-born, My might, and the first-fruits of my strength; The excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power.

tanach-bereishit|49:4.en: Unstable as water, have not thou the excellency; Because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; Then defiledst thou it—he went up to my couch.

tanach-bereishit|49:5.en: Simeon and Levi are brethren; Weapons of violence their kinship.

tanach-bereishit|49:6.en: Let my soul not come into their council; Unto their assembly let my glory not be united; For in their anger they slew men, And in their self-will they houghed oxen.

tanach-bereishit|49:7.en: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce, And their wrath, for it was cruel; I will divide them in Jacob, And scatter them in Israel

tanach-bereishit|49:8.en: Judah, thee shall thy brethren praise; Thy hand shall be on the neck of thine enemies; Thy father's sons shall bow down before thee.

tanach-bereishit|49:9.en: Judah is a lion's whelp; From the prey, my son, thou art gone up. He stooped down, he couched as a lion, And as a lioness; who shall rouse him up?

tanach-bereishit|49:10.en: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, Nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, As long as men come to Shiloh; And unto him shall the obedience of the peoples be.

tanach-bereishit|49:11.en: Binding his foal unto the vine, And his ass's colt unto the choice vine; He washeth his garments in wine, And his vesture in the blood of grapes;

tanach-bereishit|49:12.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, And his teeth white with milk.

tanach-bereishit|49:13.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the shore of the sea, And he shall be a shore for ships, And his flank shall be upon Zidon.

tanach-bereishit|49:14.en: Issachar is a large-boned ass, Couching down between the sheepfolds.

tanach-bereishit|49:15.en: For he saw a resting-place that it was good, And the land that it was pleasant; And he bowed his shoulder to bear, And became a servant under taskwork.

tanach-bereishit|49:16.en: Dan shall judge his people, As one of the tribes of Israel.

tanach-bereishit|49:17.en: Dan shall be a serpent in the way, A horned snake in the path, That biteth the horse's heels, So that his rider falleth backward.

tanach-bereishit|49:18.en: I wait for Thy salvation, O Lord.

tanach-bereishit|49:19.en: Gad, a troop shall troop upon him; But he shall troop upon their heel.

tanach-bereishit|49:20.en: As for Asher, his bread shall be fat, And he shall yield royal dainties.

tanach-bereishit|49:21.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: He giveth goodly words.

tanach-bereishit|49:22.en: Joseph is a fruitful vine, A fruitful vine by a fountain; Its branches run over the wall.

tanach-bereishit|49:23.en: The archers have dealt bitterly with him, And shot at him, and hated him;

tanach-bereishit|49:24.en: But his bow abode firm, And the arms of his hands were made supple, By the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, From thence, from the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel,

tanach-bereishit|49:25.en: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee, And by the Almighty, who shall bless thee, With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that coucheth beneath, Blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

tanach-bereishit|49:26.en: The blessings of thy father Are mighty beyond the blessings of my progenitors Unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills; They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of the prince among his brethren.

tanach-bereishit|49:27.en: Benjamin is a wolf that raveneth; In the morning he devoureth the prey, And at even he divideth the spoil.'

tanach-bereishit|49:28.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is it that their father spoke unto them and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

tanach-bereishit|49:29.en: And he charged them, and said unto them: 'I am to be gathered unto my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

tanach-bereishit|49:30.en: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a burying-place.

tanach-bereishit|49:31.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

tanach-bereishit|49:32.en: The field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.'

tanach-bereishit|49:33.en: And when Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and expired, and was gathered unto his people.

tanach-bereishit|50:1.en: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

tanach-bereishit|50:2.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel.

tanach-bereishit|50:3.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of embalming. And the Egyptians wept for him threescore and ten days.

tanach-bereishit|50:4.en: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke unto the house of Pharaoh, saying: 'If now I have found favour in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying:

tanach-bereishit|50:5.en: My father made me swear, saying: Lo, I die; in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come back.'

tanach-bereishit|50:6.en: And Pharaoh said: 'Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.'

tanach-bereishit|50:7.en: And Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

tanach-bereishit|50:8.en: and all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house; only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

tanach-bereishit|50:9.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen; and it was a very great company.

tanach-bereishit|50:10.en: And they came to the threshing-floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they wailed with a very great and sore wailing; and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

tanach-bereishit|50:11.en: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said: 'This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians.' Wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

tanach-bereishit|50:12.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them.

tanach-bereishit|50:13.en: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burying-place, of Ephron the Hittite, in front of Mamre.

tanach-bereishit|50:14.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

tanach-bereishit|50:15.en: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said: 'It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully requite us all the evil which we did unto him.'

tanach-bereishit|50:16.en: And they sent a message unto Joseph, saying: 'Thy father did command before he died, saying:

tanach-bereishit|50:17.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph: Forgive, I pray thee now, the transgression of thy brethren, and their sin, for that they did unto thee evil. And now, we pray thee, forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of thy father.' And Joseph wept when they spoke unto him.

tanach-bereishit|50:18.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said: 'Behold, we are thy bondmen.'

tanach-bereishit|50:19.en: And Joseph said unto them: 'Fear not; for am I in the place of God?

tanach-bereishit|50:20.en: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

tanach-bereishit|50:21.en: Now therefore fear ye not; I will sustain you, and your little ones.' And he comforted them, and spoke kindly unto them.

tanach-bereishit|50:22.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house; and Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.

tanach-bereishit|50:23.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation; the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were born upon Joseph's knees.

tanach-bereishit|50:24.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren: 'I die; but God will surely remember you, and bring you up out of this land unto the land which He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.'

tanach-bereishit|50:25.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying: 'God will surely remember you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.'

tanach-bereishit|50:26.en: So Joseph died, being a hundred and ten years old. And they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
